jobs.title: Program Coordinator (5156C), Summer Sessions, Study Abroad, Lifelong Learning & University Extension
jobs.description:
Program Coordinator (5156C), Summer Sessions, Study Abroad, Lifelong Learning & University Extension About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
Summer Sessions, Study Abroad, Lifelong Learning & University Extension (SSALLEX) is the extended education division of the University of California, Berkeley and an essential part of the University's mission to extend the research and scholarship of UC Berkeley to a global community.
  
  
SSALLEX is a vibrant and dynamic organization that enables more than 60,000 visiting UC and potential Cal students; parents, faculty, academic units, international business partners, and central campus service providers engage in campus activities. The department provides more than 2,000 summer courses, early-start programs, study abroad experiences, global internships, and year-around programs or courses, lectures, special events and interest circles for older adults.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Based on the continued growth and expansion of the First-Year Edge & Transfer Edge program, the Program Coordinator is needed to support the execution and management of the program's operations. This position would work with the Director and would be responsible for applying advanced student services expertise and coordinating the academic advising, logistical, programmatic, and administrative operations of the First-Year Edge & Transfer Edge summer program for newly admitted UC Berkeley students.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is November 23, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Academic Advising - 30%
  
  
Apply full range of student support services to newly admitted students pursuing the First-Year Edge & Transfer Edge program.
  
Provide on-going advising to prospective and matriculated students, families, and legal guardians and effectively manage a high volume of inquiries from prospective and matriculated students as well as campus and internal partners
  
Advise Director on university and program specific policies and procedures as well as program development, administration and general logistics.
  
Advise students on topics such as but not limited to eligibility requirements, opt-in/opt-out process, financial aid, academics, housing, support services, and resources for the course enrollment process.
  
  
Resolve Student Services-related Issues and Grievances - 10%
  
  
Resolve student services-related issues and grievances during and after the course of the program, including course enrollment, billing, withdrawal/cancellation, appeals process, and other related inquiries.
  
  
Recruitment and Outreach - 10%
  
  
Plan, implement and participate in virtual, local, domestic, and other outreach events and recruitment opportunities primarily in California as well as hosting and facilitating in-person and online outreach events, such as information sessions and pre-program webinars
  
  
Student Conduct - 5%
  
  
Responsible for interpreting organization policies and advising students and faculty on student conduct, student grievances, disputes, and issues regarding discrimination.
  
  
Student Orientation - 5%
  
  
Oversees and may conduct orientations of new students.
  
  
Events - 5%
  
  
Plan and implement student programming, events and orientations aimed at equipping newly admitted first-year and transfer students with the knowledge to succeed during the course of the program and in their transition to UC Berkeley
  
  
Alumni Recruitment Network - 5%
  
  
Develops and enhances an alumni recruitment network. Including coordinating the recruitment, hiring, and training process of student staff including program assistants and program ambassadors
  
  
Emergency and Crisis - 5%
  
  
Support emergency and crisis management intervention
  
  
Confidential Conduct Records - 5%
  
  
Maintain confidential conduct records as defined by FERPA, Clery, Title IX, and other regulations
  
  
Student Databases and Analysis - 5%
  
  
Create, update, and maintain student databases and provide data insights and analysis when needed.
  
  
Program Literature and Resources - 5%
  
  
Develop and maintain program literature and resources, including program website and knowledge base, and maintain external and on-going communication to various constituents
  
  
Administrative and Operational Tasks - 5%
  
  
Coordinating administrative and operational tasks including but not limited to making purchases, invoice and vendor payments, expense pre-approvals, and reimbursements
  
  
Evaluate Programs and Make Recommendations - 5%
  
  
Evaluate short-term and long-term success of programs and make recommendations to changes in policy, practice, and procedure accordingly.

jobs.title: MPS Program Coordinator (4973C) - MPS Dean's Office
jobs.description:
MPS Program Coordinator (4973C) - MPS Dean's Office About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and providing space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Pla n, which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride.
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The MPS Dean's Diversity Office initiates, implements, and evaluates efforts and conducts research on student, postdoc, and faculty success in the mathematical and physical science fields with an emphasis on ensuring fair access and equitable outcomes. The Assistant Dean and their staff organize new initiatives, develop new funding, and support departmental efforts to students, and receive all work duties directly from the Assistant Dean. Collaborates with professors, graduate students, postdoctoral fellows, faculty, staff, and administrators from UCB and national partners.
  
  
Currently projects underway include MPS Scholars and the MPS Scholarship Program at the undergraduate level, a doctoral advancement program, and a postdoc study. This position is responsible for providing programmatic, administrative, and financial coordination for MPS Dean's Office. Provides support to the Assistant Dean. The Assistant Dean advises the Deans and Department Chairs, manages and provides assistance to several student organizations, conducts research, develops new programs, and works to enhance equity among the faculty, staff, and students in the MPS departments.
  
  
The position requires in-depth understanding of campus policies and administrative practices. The position holder is a key point of contact for all MPS Dean's Office business and must be able to work with a high degree of independence with good judgement and follow through.
  
  
MPS Scholars is the official student success and mentorship program of the Mathematical and Physical Sciences (MPS) Dean's Office, offered collaboratively with the Departments of Astronomy, Earth and Planetary Science, Mathematics, and Physics. Open to all intended and declared MPS majors, MPS Scholars provides opportunities to build community, explore academic and career pathways, and thrive throughout the Berkeley experience.
  
  
Since launching in Fall 2022, thousands of students have participated in MPS Scholars through mentorship, events, workshops, and academic and career resources.
  
  
MPS Scholars is a structured program, supported by funding from the Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation. It provides activities and opportunities such as: A supportive mentoring network of advanced students, faculty, professional scientists, and alumni. Welcome and orientation programs for incoming students. Research and internship opportunities in academic and industry settings. Career development workshops, courses, networking events, and graduate school preparation. Academic resources designed to support success in MPS majors. Retreats, social events, and community-building activities that connect students with peers, graduate mentors, staff, alumni, and faculty across the MPS departments.
  
  
The Mathematical and Physical Sciences Scholarship Program (MPSSP) awards up to $15,000 per year in scholarship support to eligible students in Astronomy, Earth and Planetary Science, Mathematics, and Physics. Funded by the National Science Foundation's S-STEM program, MPSSP scholars receive financial support while participating fully in the MPS Scholars community.
  
  
At the graduate level, a bridge grant from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation grant is focused on establishing a prototype for the establishment of a Sloan Center for Systemic Change (SCSC) at Berkeley by establishing a consortium of departments working together to advance their equity goals.
  
  
At the postdoctoral level, the Postdoc Study, supported by a grant from the Heising-Simons Foundation, is designed to provide a clearer understanding of the experiences of postdoctoral scholars and causes of patterns of career selection among postdocs in the MPS fields at top-tier universities and national research facilities.
  
  
The MPS Program Coordinator coordinates and administers academic support and student success programs within the Mathematical and Physical Sciences (MPS) Dean's Office, including MPS Scholars and the NSF S-STEM Scholarship Program. The position supports the development and implementation of programs designed to enhance the academic, professional, and personal success of undergraduate and graduate students, with particular attention to students who may face barriers to academic success.
  
  
Working under the direction of the Assistant Dean and in collaboration with faculty, staff, students, and campus and external partners, the Program Coordinator provides programmatic support, coordinates mentoring and professional development activities, supports students in navigating academic and other challenges, and assists with program assessment and evaluation. The position also coordinates program communications and outreach, supervises student and peer staff,

jobs.title: Research Program Coordinator – Reproductive Health
jobs.description:
**Employment Duration:** 6 months

The Research Program Coordinator will serve as a key analyst and coordinator supporting the programmatic and research activities of the Principal Investigator within UCSF’s Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences.

The position supports multiple grant-funded research projects focused on patient-provider communication, particularly in the areas of pharmacies, sexual and reproductive health, and empathy in healthcare. The Coordinator will conduct moderately complex qualitative and quantitative analytical work, support manuscript preparation and submission, and coordinate research, teaching, and mentorship activities. The research does not involve clinical trials.

The Coordinator will collaborate with UCSF departments, the San Francisco Department of Public Health, research and administrative partners, and outside consultants. The role will also evaluate research processes, data collection and storage practices, and available technologies and services to identify alternatives and make sound recommendations.

The position is within UCSF’s Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences, a major academic department in the School of Medicine committed to healthcare, education, and research. The role is based within the department’s Zuckerberg San Francisco General division, whose mission includes promoting justice, quality, and equity in women’s healthcare.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct qualitative and quantitative data collection, cleaning, analysis, and other analytical activities supporting multiple research studies focused on patient-provider communication, pharmacies, sexual and reproductive health, and empathy in healthcare.
* Develop and support systems for research data collection, research-subject communication, and confidential data management.
* Prepare, edit, and modify manuscripts, presentations, abstracts, study instruments, research posters, syllabus materials, letters of recommendation, and other research-related documents.
* Conduct professional literature reviews and gather, synthesize, and analyze information to prepare reports and analyses for the Principal Investigator.
* Prepare and present research summaries, reports, and other materials for meetings and internal and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate research, teaching, and mentorship activities, including meetings, conference activities, research activities, grant applications, vendor selection and setup, and joint abstract submissions.
* Coordinate program and project activities with research and project staff and collaborate across UCSF departments and administrative units.
* Interface with partners including the Office of Sponsored Research, Research Administration, and San Francisco Department of Public Health departments as needed.
* Evaluate issues and research processes, gather relevant information, assess alternatives, and recommend approaches to data collection and storage based on available technologies and services.
* Support activities that advance UCSF PRIDE Values and Principles of Community and contribute to an inclusive environment where individuals are treated with dignity and respect.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in any area.
* At least one year of related experience or equivalent training.
* Working knowledge of common organizational or research-specific computer applications, including Microsoft Office, particularly word processing and intermediate Excel functions.
* Proficient verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities within demanding timeframes.
* Ability to exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality.
* Demonstrated ability to use sound judgment when responding to issues and concerns.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, research, and synthesize large amounts of data with strong attention to detail.
* Demonstrated interest in sexual and reproductive health, including comfort with family planning and abortion, and infectious diseases including HIV.
* Knowledge of qualitative research concepts and applications.
Ability to take initiative and direction and complete tasks in a timely and comprehensive manner.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in public health, behavioral science, or another related area.
* Three years of experience working in an academic, research, public health, or related setting.
* Knowledge of survey software such as REDCap or Qualtrics.

  

**About UCSF**

  

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells.

  
  

**Pride Values**

  

UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values .

  

In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. We are committed to building a broadly diverse community, nurturing a culture that is welcoming and supportive, and engaging diverse ideas for the provision of culturally competent education, discovery, and patient care. Additional information about UCSF is available here .

  

Join us to find a rewarding career contributing to improving healthcare worldwide.

  
  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
**At DPR, roles and responsibilities are more than describing a job title—they are a commitment to building great things together. The job description(s) below defines core responsibilities and the scope of the role and is a starting point. Every employee is expected to lead from where they are, take ownership of outcomes, and always act in the best interest of the team, customer, project and organization.**  
  
**As a purpose-driven organization on a journey to be most admired, we rely on trust, shared leadership, open communication, disciplined action and a deep respect for the individual to drive exceptional performance. Success is not just about what we build, but who we build and how we build it: with integrity, enjoyment, uniqueness and an ever-forward mindset.**

**Job Summary:**  
Supports construction project teams and contributes to achieving Business Unit project management objectives. Manages a defined scope, phase, or geographic area of a project, or supports delivery of smaller projects, to build foundational project management capability and accountability. Assists in the coordination and delivery of construction projects by applying knowledge of construction activities, methodologies, and industry standards. Coordinates work across multidisciplinary teams, including contractors and internal partners, and supports oversight of assigned project engineers, field office coordinators, or similar roles under guidance. Supports coordination among multidisciplinary project teams, contractors, and stakeholders to help ensure project requirements, schedules, and quality standards are met. Contributes to efficient project execution by tracking team progress, reporting on project performance, resolving routine issues, and supporting project budgets, forecasts, contract administration, and cost controls to contribute to financial targets and risk mitigation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
Supports the management and development of project teams, by assisting with onboarding, individual skill development activities, and basic training coordination, and may provide day-to-day guidance and task coordination for assigned project engineers, field office coordinators, or similar roles when staffing and project needs support this, fostering skill growth and ensuring quality performance under guidance.
  
Coordinates day-to-day project activities by working with project teams, tracking progress, and escalating issues of some complexity to management as needed, while maintaining regular field presence, participating in safety meetings including stretch and flex, and engaging in high-risk activity awareness to support safe, planned, and controlled project outcomes.
  
Assists with procurement of project-related materials, equipment, and specialty trade subcontractors, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with work sequences and field requirements.
  
Communicates project updates, risks, and changes to stakeholders, applying foundational knowledge and experience in project management.
  
Applies and reinforces established quality control measures and safety protocols, maintaining accountability for adherence to site-specific safety plans and contributing to a culture of zero incidents.
  
Monitors project performance, identifies routine issues, and recommends corrective actions.
  
Maintains accurate project documentation for compliance, reporting, and future reference.
  
  
**Education Qualifications:**  
Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, architecture, a related field, or equivalent experience required.
  
  
**Work Experience:**  
5 years of experience in construction engineering, project engineering, or a related field required.
  
  
**Certifications and Licenses:**  
Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) 30-Hour Construction certification preferred. OSHA 30 program completion within 6 months of hire is required.

$140,000.00- $150,000.00

jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

**Case Manager**

**Zygmunt Arendt Support Services**

**Senior Division**

**Agency Overview**

Felton Institute responds to the needs of our community by providing innovative, evidence-informed social services that transform lives. Our organization offers 50+ programs that address mental health, the unhoused, early care and education, those impacted by the justice system, transitional age youth, as well as aging adults. Our programs combine the latest scientific research with cultural sensitivity and a deep commitment to supporting and reflecting the communities we serve. Felton offers a dynamic, challenging, and supportive work environment where we encourage the use of professional development, that staff can utilize throughout their career.

**Program and Division Description**

Felton’s Senior Division specializes in a full continuum of mental health services for older adults in outpatient clinics, the community, and supportive housing sites, as well as programs in employment training, economic security, case management, advocacy, and social connection and inclusion.

Felton’s Zygmunt Arendt Supportive Services Program provides on-site case management, wellness support, and behavioral health services. Services aim to support tenants in maintaining stable housing and improving access to resources. Tenants are formerly unhoused adults with co-occurring mental health, substance abuse, medical problems, and limited experience living independently. Support services include case management, referral to and coordination with primary medical care, substance abuse and psychiatric treatment referrals, benefits counseling and client advocacy, meal programs, health education, community building, tenant organizing, and all other case management functions. Felton is committed to implementing evidence-based practices and research within its community-based services.

**Job Description**

Under the supervision of the Lead Case Manager and/or supervisor, the Case Manager works in direct service with individuals experiencing homelessness, substance use, mental health needs, and medical complexity. The Case Manager holds a full caseload, works directly with the interdisciplinary team to reach out and engage all tenants, assess their needs upon move-in and throughout their residency, and connect tenants to those services, working to overcome obstacles with the residents and their care team. The Case Manager will connect tenants to services including benefits, entitlements, vocational or educational resources, mental health, medical, and substance use services, and any other appropriate resources, as needed. This person will also provide support to individuals in learning independent living skills, communication skills, social skills, and other necessary skills to support independence, maintain housing stability, and promote mental health recovery.

The Case Manager meets with and evaluates the needs of clients and develops a treatment plan in collaboration with the client. The Case Manager maintains accurate, detailed records of client contacts and incident reports as required by Felton, HSH, ONE system, and county and state regulations. This person will also bring expertise regarding the specific needs of older adults and those entering housing from homelessness, as well as connections to community resources, recreational opportunities, and other connections to necessary services.

**Specific Responsibilities**

* Participate closely with an interdisciplinary team and collaborate with property management.
* Communicate effectively, orally and in writing, with all internal and external team members and with partnering agencies.
* Participate in intakes and service plan development for adults with a history of being unhoused and other psychiatric or medical conditions or disabilities.
* Recommend case management services, which could include connection to primary care, coordination with other providers and community resources, housing stabilization services, etc.
* Link clients to basic needs, including income, housing, job training, insurance, and/or nutrition, among other resources.
* Maintain records of each client contact or service in accordance with mandated standards of HSH and Felton. Meet requirements of timely access for client care and documentation.
* Participate in team meetings and case conferences through presentation of cases, discussion of issues, and exchange of information and ideas.
* Provide crisis intervention to prevent hospitalization and collaborate with clinicians or other providers as needed. Respond to emergency situations as they arise.
* Develop systems and maintain ongoing training, including developing specializations in evidence-based practices for the teams.
* Accountable for data input into the ONE and CIRCE systems to maintain client records related to housing per HSH standards.
* Deliver exceptional customer service to tenants, community partners, and team.
* Provide activities and groups with the tenants.
* Advise tenants to basic needs, including income, housing, job training, insurance, and/or nutrition, among other resources.
* Recommend specific housing needs via training, coaching, or community resource referrals to support tenants in maintaining stable housing.
* Participate in emergency wellness checks.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Psychology, or related fields of study required.
* Comprehensive knowledge of mental health and substance abuse counseling, assessment, and crisis intervention skills.
* Willingness to work from a strength-based, harm reduction, client-centered model with an emphasis on evidence-based practices.
* Ability to work cooperatively on a multidisciplinary team, and to work with people of various ethnic and cultural backgrounds.

jobs.title: LRL Facilities Operations Manager
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
Research Capital & Site Operations Manager
  
  
Summary
  
This role sits where capital planning meets day-to-day lab operations. You’ll decide where capital dollars go, keep our research sites running, and manage the vendors and facilities that make the science possible. Your job is to make sure labs have the equipment, supplies, and services they need, and that our space and infrastructure keep pace as discovery programs grow. You’ll weigh cost, risk, and impact, then turn those calls into clear plans. The goal is simple: researchers spend their time on discovery, not on broken equipment or unresolved facility issues.
  
  
**Roles and Responsibilities of the Position:**  

* Identify and manage external vendors across multiple functions within the facility operation to ensure alignment with LRL and Oncology department heads and scientists.
* Responsible for oversight of the installation and qualification of laboratory equipment.
* Work with the LRL HSE and IT department teams on strategy, long-term planning, new construction, and project execution.
* Manage and review service contracts.
* Oversee the design, construction and occupancy of laboratory and office spaces for the LRL employees on site.
* Check completed work by vendors and contractors.
* Contribute to the creation of Site Operational Budgets and annual Site Capital Budgets for LRL. Ensure site budgets are managed and maintained. Provide budget forecasts for site as required.
* Frequent contact and interaction with department heads, outside agencies/architects, and government and municipal representatives.
* Allocate office space according to needs of LRL personnel.
* Keep financial and non-financial records.
* Forecast, allocate, and supervise the financial and physical resources of the facility management.
* Recommend maintenance, mechanical, electrical, and facility design modifications.
* Prepare cost estimates for moves and equipment.
* Ensure that the facility is clean and maintained according to company policy and procedures.
* Negotiate bids and contracts for third-party services.
* Manage and coordinate work with 3rd-party vendors including tracking work order completion, vendor and client follow up, validating/approving subcontractor invoices.
* Oversee the implementation of Health, Safety and Environmental programs for LRL and Oncology personnel on site.

Uber Eats is one of the largest and most complex marketplace businesses, connecting customers, merchants, and couriers across restaurants, grocery and retail stores, as well as merchant white-labeled delivery. Our US&C Marketplace Ops team sits at the center of that ecosystem, owning the health, efficiency, and reliability of the marketplace across millions of daily orders.  
  
As a Senior Operations Manager on the team, you’ll help shape marketplace strategy and performance, leveraging data to understand how the marketplace is performing, identify opportunities, and drive improvements across customer experience, courier efficiency, and unit economics. You’ll tackle problems across the marketplace stack from dispatch and pricing, to supply and merchant operations, in partnership with Product, Commercial, Finance, and other Operations teams.

**What You’ll Do**  

* Develop strategies that optimize marketplace health by balancing reliability, courier supply, customer experience, and unit economics.

* Lead high-impact operational initiatives from strategy through execution, measuring results and driving continuous improvement.
* Partner with Product, Finance, Commercial, and other Ops teams to shape priorities, evaluate experiments, and support the successful rollout of new product and operational capabilities.

**Basic Qualifications**

**Preferred Qualifications**

For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**

Rippling is hiring for a **Customer Revenue Strategy & Operations Senior Manager** to manage critical customer sales strategy, operations and reporting capabilities for our account management organization (“AM”). This role will support the full design of Rippling’s Customer Territory Operations strategy and will monitor and report on execution to that strategy. This year we are hiring and expanding the AM team into international markets which come with a host of new challenges and opportunities to deliver innovative Territory Operations programs and execution for the Organization. This role will partner closely with senior leadership to build strategic business plans for the business. They will work to operationalize these plans throughout the year. They will own the build of critical business reporting and present on several cadences (weekly ad-hoc, monthly via the MBR, quarterly via strategy memo production). In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with leadership across interconnected parts of the business (sales, marketing, customer experience) and be expected to cross-functionally partner with teams to manage business performance and surface key insights. Additionally, you will broadly support a wide-range of post-sales operations including using AI to optimize book building through SQL skills and deep data analyses and enhance customer data integrity within our Salesforce instance. Your cross functional partners will focus on the technical account management (“TAM”) organization. This is a very exciting position located at the cross-section of several fast-paced and high-performing teams.

The ideal candidate will have worked in fast-paced environments before, ideally at a multi-product SaaS company and will have made a measurable impact to the sales organization. You should also be comfortable tackling ambiguous and challenging problems and working independently as well as part of a team. This is an opportunity to work on high-visibility strategic initiatives in a rapidly growing sales organization.

**This role will be based in our San Francisco, CA office and will require being in office 3x/week.**

**What you'll do**

* **Business Partner and Team Player:** Act as a business partner for Sales & GTM leadership. You will be a strategic thought partner and responsible for the operational cadence of the business. Coordinate with revenue operations teammates on systems and process improvements for the sales organization. Partner cross-functionally on key components of our annual planning process including modeling and target setting.
* **Operational Management:** Operates at the intersection of 30,000+ worldwide customers who are managed by Account Managers and Technical Account Managers who work within our SFDC instance. Design and implement more efficient and optimized ways to route customers, build books, and launch new markets. Build new data capture strategies to improve operational efficiency. Oversee existing data operations and get hands-on with instrumenting, improving and optimizing Salesforce workflows.
* **Strategic and Operational Planning:** Own territory modeling for customer facing organizations. Lead building of detailed strategic and operational plans. Ensure model keeps pace with the evolution of the business. Support team in developing a more robust understanding of the business. Support operationalization of plans.
* **Customer Logo Forecasting:** Own customer logo forecasting processes. Lead/support weekly calls. Oversee forecasting performance and accuracy and increase both over time. Improve process over time and develop new ways to analyze the business.
* **Reporting:** Own monthly MBR reporting. Build, manage and share materials to executive leadership. Surface insights to leadership that are both quantified and actionable. Maintain deep knowledge of the business to ensure reporting accurately reflects state of the business as we continue to scale. Design and build analytics to measure KPIs.
* **Ad-hoc analysis and special projects:** Develop a deep understanding of the entire customer business at Rippling to inform your ability to provide ad hoc analysis support.Leverage data to surface key insights about the business and provide thoughtful, logical, sound recommendations to leadership.

**Qualifications**

* 4-7+ years of work experience in Consulting, Finance, Sales Operations, Sales Strategy, Sales Analytics or other related fields
* Requires SQL and BI experience; Salesforce experience is a nice to have
* Proactive, self-starter with direct experience driving projects that deliver measurable impact to GTM teams
* Able to work with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-moving startup or a hyper growth environment
* Strong analytical, modeling, and conceptual problem-solving skills
* Excellent Excel and financial modeling skills
* Excellent communication skills (written, verbal)
* Experience driving cross-functional initiatives with speed and efficiency
* Excellent cross-functional stakeholder management

jobs.title: Reality Labs Product Data Operations Program Manager - AI Data and Evaluation
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Reality Labs Product Data Operations Program Manager to drive human data annotation, AI-assisted quality, and model and data evaluation across Reality Labs, where capabilities like hand tracking, gesture recognition, and generative AI experiences depend on models trained and evaluated on high-quality human data.Our scope spans the full lifecycle of the data: designing the tasks that produce it, deploying AI and automation to scale how it is labeled and checked, and building the evaluation practices that decide whether the data and model outputs meet the bar.If you are energized by AI-driven workflows and measurement rigor, this role is for you. You will take ownership of an established set of operational tools and extend them as programs grow. You should be excited and comfortable using AI coding tools and owning the results.  
  
  

### **Reality Labs Product Data Operations Program Manager - AI Data and Evaluation Responsibilities:**

* Own a portfolio of annotation and evaluation programs across Meta Reality Labs' perception and generative AI experiences, running each through established workflows and shared tooling so every delivery can be traced, reproduced, and handed off
* Partner with research scientists, engineers, and technical program managers to translate model and evaluation requirements into task designs, rubrics, rater guidelines, and acceptance criteria
* Operate, maintain, and extend existing program tooling, including task configurations, data pipelines, queries, dashboards, and automated reports, with the help of AI coding assistants
* Define how quality is measured for each program: break down what a correct answer means into verifiable checks, set the acceptance rules a delivery must pass, and decide how rater disagreement is resolved, rather than applying one-size-fits-all metrics
* Design, configure, and operate AI and automation across the annotation pipeline, including pre-annotation, LLM and VLM judges, and quality triage, and measure where they meet the bar before they replace a human step
* Build and maintain evaluation practices, including gold-standard datasets, model versus human comparison, human preference evaluation for generative models, and the accuracy thresholds that determine whether data and AI outputs meet the bar
* Analyze operational data to identify quality and throughput trends, building the dashboards and leadership-facing reporting that drive decisions, and stating the coverage behind every quality number
* Drive resolution of risks and blockers across vendor capacity, tooling, data availability, and model training schedules
* Manage external annotation vendors, including rater training, throughput, quality feedback, and per-unit cost. Document the systems and decisions you own so that any program can be handed to another program manager without loss

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's degree in a directly related field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta
* Bachelor's degree in a directly related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 4+ years of experience in program management, operations, or technical operations within an AI, ML, research, or data-driven organization
* Analytical experience using data to identify trends, diagnose operational issues, and influence program direction
* Experience building or deploying automation or AI solutions in production workflows
* Experience in communicating and influencing multiple cross-functional stakeholders and leadership
* Experience solving problems and breaking down ambiguous issues into component parts to develop solutions
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, applications, and industry trends sufficient to engage with technical teams and inform operational decisions

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in AR/VR, wearables, or consumer electronics, or with perception data such as hand, body, or eye tracking
* Experience running human data annotation programs at scale, including task design, rater guidelines, and quality measures for tasks with no gold standard
* Experience using AI coding agents to build or maintain operational tooling, reports, or workflows
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience owning program budgets, cost forecasting, or per-unit cost tracking
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience designing evaluations for generative AI systems, including rubrics, human preference studies, or LLM-as-judge methods
* Working familiarity with how computer vision and machine learning models are trained and evaluated, including benchmark datasets, ground truth, accuracy, and agreement measurement, and a high-level understanding of model limitations
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience in writing SQL to analyze large datasets

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. jobs.description:
**CHURCH OF OUR SAVIOUR, MILL VALLEY - OPERATIONS MANAGER**

**POSITION DESCRIPTION**

**Overview:**

The Operations Manager has general responsibility for the management of all office functions,

bookkeeping and overseeing the maintenance and repair of the buildings and grounds of

the Episcopal Church of Our Saviour, Mill Valley. The person in this role will often be the first

impression members of the public and parishioners have of the parish and so in addition to

ensuring that the operations of the parish all are smoothly running, this person should enjoy

creating a warm and hospitable environment. All are Welcome at the Church of Our Saviour.

This position reports directly to the acting Rector of the parish and provides him/her direct

administrative support while also providing administrative support to the Vestry (lay board of

the parish), other clergy, and key parish ministry leaders.

**Key Responsibilities: (detailed accountabilities below)**

● Bookkeeping - this role will be responsible for timely and accurate bookkeeping for the

parish, including payables and receivables, donation and pledge management, regular

reporting for diocesan and parish needs, review of invoices, and handling deposits.

● Office functions - the successful Operations Manager ensures that the office is well

organized, well-equipped, tidy, welcoming and stocked and that systems and processes,

tools and technologies are in place to absorb requests from across the parish. The office

functions of the Operations Managers will include administrative tasks (such as

scheduling facilities use, responding to and appropriately directing phone and email

inquiries, managing the office accounts, subscriptions, machines and supplies), member

management (including maintaining and filing parish records, meeting minutes,

updating the parish directory, developing a robust communications program, ensuring all

announcements and events are published across communications channels and digital

platforms) and leader support (including staff and ministry leaders with scheduling

volunteers, procuring necessary supplies, and producing materials for church services,

such as bulletins, hand-outs, music inserts, etc.)

● Building and Grounds Management - in coordination with Junior Warden, the Office

Manager is responsible for scheduling regular and ad hoc work, for the maintenance and

repair of COS facilities (including church building, grounds and nearby rectory) and

ensures successful and timely completion of maintenance and repairs. This includes

management of janitorial services, gardening and landscaping services, handymen and

specialist service providers (musical instrument maintenance, stained glass repair,

plumbing, electrical, etc.)

**Required Qualifications and Competencies:**

● Equivalent to a minimum of three (3) years of administrative experience;

● Facility with computers and applications related to the work, including word processing,

spreadsheet applications, web design, database / CRM, and SaaS workspaces are a

must;

● Knowledge of basic accounting and bookkeeping practices;

● Strong english language skills, including, spelling, grammar, and punctuation relevant to

business communications;

● Ability to understand, interpret, apply, and explain the church’s policies and procedures;

● Use of tact, initiative, discretion, and judgment within church policy and legal guidelines

in sensitive situations;

● Ability to establish, maintain, and foster positive and effective working relationships with

those contacted in the course of work;

● Ability to provide a high level of customer service when dealing with the public,

parishioners, church staff and volunteers;

● Demonstrated ability to organize own work, set priorities, meet critical deadlines and

follow-up on assignments;

● Propensity to take initiative and exercise independent judgement in decision making

within the scope of the role;

● Ability to effectively coordinate the work of certain vendors, contractors, and service

providers through delivery of clear instruction and timely responses

● Ability and desire to effectively leverage technology to improve efficiency of office

processes and systems

● Willingness and desire to observe any operating gaps and to “fill-in” when needed with

other duties as needed or as assigned.

● Experience in a church or other ministry setting is preferred. Knowledge of the

Episcopal Church is a huge plus.

**Detailed Accountabilities:**

**Bookkeeping:**

● Reviews invoices for payment, forwards to appropriate individuals for approval and

follows up until approval is received.

● Handles entry and resolution of all payables and receivables.

● Tracks donation and annual pledges.

● Provides regular reporting for the Diocese of California.

● Provides regular financial reports for the Finance Committee and Vestry review.

● Prepares for and participates in monthly finance committee meetings.

● Assists in preparation of annual parish reports to the congregation and diocese.

● Prepares weekly deposit slips for offerings and checks received.

● Distributes quarterly and annual mailings to pledging parishioners.

● Submitting hourly payroll schedule.

● Reconciling bank account.

● Paying diocesan assessment.

● Paying employee benefits.

● Paying pensions.

**Office Functions:**

● Responds to requests for information and resources via email, telephone, and in-person

visits.

● Sorts incoming mail; sends parish mailings and other outgoing mail.

● Maintains office equipment and office subscriptions: including copiers, computers, and

telephone system in working order; coordinates service as needed.

● Maintains office supplies and supplies needed for ministries.

● Maintains licenses, passwords, and media for computer related tools and services used

by or for the parish (e.g., computer applications, website, ISP, telephone, equipment).

● Maintains personnel files for all regular staff

* Frame enterprise opportunities so they are defensible to leadership on both sides, including the mutual value, the commitment required from each party, and the criteria that make a project worth doing at all

jobs.title: Product Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

As a Product Enablement Manager, you'll make sure Braze's most technical customer-facing teams fully understand our product. This job has two main work streams. You'll run the internal process for building product enablement, taking each project from intake to launch so content is accurate, on time, and matched to the release calendar. You'll also run deep, hands-on enablement sessions for Technical Account Managers (TAMs), Technical Architects (TAs), Support, and Solutions Consultants (SCs), so they can design, troubleshoot, and position Braze with confidence.

*Project Management*

* Design and own the end-to-end process for building internal product enablement: intake, prioritization, scoping, timelines, SME coordination, content review, and launch
* Line up enablement deliverables with the product release calendar so technical teams are ready before features reach customers
* Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Documentation, and the broader Enablement team so everyone knows who owns what, what's due when, and what's been approved
* Build and maintain repeatable templates, workflows, and tracking (e.g., Jira, or Claude) that make the build process scalable and visible to stakeholders
* Share status, risks, and tradeoffs with stakeholders early, and adjust priorities quickly when launches or business needs change

*Technical Product Enablement*

* Design and deliver deep, hands-on enablement sessions (labs, workshops, live demos, and troubleshooting walkthroughs) built around the day-to-day work of TAMs, TAs, Support, and SCs
* Create and maintain resources such as technical FAQs, reference architectures, sandbox exercises, recorded deep-dives, and certification paths, working with SMEs in Product, Engineering, and Product Marketing
* Run regular needs assessments with technical team leaders to find knowledge gaps, recurring escalation themes, and support case trends, then turn them into targeted enablement
* Measure impact with assessments, certification completion, survey feedback, and operational data (e.g., ticket deflection, time-to-resolution, escalation volume, technical win rates), and use the results to improve programs

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 3+ years of experience in technical or product enablement, with a strong track record of designing and delivering advanced technical training and project management
* 7+ years of combined experience in a technical customer-facing or product role (e.g., Technical Account Manager, Technical Architect, Solutions Consultant, Technical Support, Sales Engineer, or Product)
* Strong hands-on knowledge of APIs, SDKs, data integrations, and common programming concepts. You're comfortable going deep with highly technical audiences
* Experience with Braze or another customer engagement platform; experience with mobile/web SDK implementation is a strong plus
* Proven program and project management skills, including running multi-stakeholder content development cycles against fixed launch dates
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts without losing accuracy, and to tailor content for different technical roles
* Strong relationship management skills, with credibility among engineers, product managers, and technical team leaders
* Analytical skills to assess data, find trends, and turn insights into actionable enablement
* Experience with LMS platforms, sandbox/lab environments, and content authoring tools is a plus
* A Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
* Moderate travel required
* Business-fluent English is essential

If you enjoy getting deep into the technical details, running complex projects to completion, and helping technical teams become trusted experts for our customers, we'd love to hear from you.

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $101,000 and $130,000/year with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $123,000 and $160,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

*Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at* *here**. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.*

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

* Competitive compensation that may include equity
* Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
* Flexible paid time off

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Project Coordinator

**Company:** Componentry  
**Location:** Fremont, CA — fully onsite  
**Reports to:** President  
**Type:** Full-time, non-exempt, hourly  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m., including a 30-minute unpaid meal break  
**Pay:** $28–$42 per hour, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated skills

About Componentry

Componentry helps hardware companies source and manage materials, build electronic and electromechanical assemblies, and keep production moving. We work as an extension of our customers’ teams, from quoting and procurement through production.

We’re looking for a Project Coordinator to connect the people, information, and actions needed to carry customer jobs from order review through delivery.

The role

You’ll maintain a clear picture of active jobs, follow up on commitments, identify risks, and coordinate solutions so work keeps moving.

Working directly with our President, you’ll partner with procurement, receiving, production, suppliers, and customers. You’ll track what has been purchased, what is outstanding, what is ready to kit or build, and what needs to happen to meet delivery commitments.

You’ll own the shared job dashboard and connect existing purchasing sheets, receiving records, and production schedules. Information should be accessible to the team without someone having to reconstruct a status report whenever an update is needed.

We’re open to training someone with strong organization, initiative, and follow-through. Your independence and decision-making authority will grow as you learn our business and demonstrate sound judgment.

What you’ll ownJob planning and visibility

* Review new orders against quoted lead times, checking material availability and production capacity with the team.
* Establish job milestones and flag conditions that could affect the expected schedule.
* Maintain the shared job dashboard, including purchasing progress, material delivery dates, receiving status, kit readiness, production, inspection, and shipment.
* Connect information across existing records and improve trackers and handoffs where needed.
* Keep blockers, next actions, owners, and deadlines visible.
* Establish regular updates with the team and escalate missing information or unresolved actions that put delivery at risk.
* Maintain traceability between customer jobs, purchase orders, and materials, including purchases supporting multiple jobs.

Follow-through and recovery

* Follow up with procurement on unpurchased items, supplier commitments, outstanding deliveries, and purchasing blockers.
* Follow up with receiving and production on discrepancies, kit completion, build progress, inspection, and rework.
* Identify stalled work, establish the next action with the responsible person, and follow through to resolution.
* Develop recovery plans with procurement and production, using their expertise to evaluate feasible options.
* Coordinate recovery actions and authorize expenses within established limits as responsibility grows.
* Escalate competing customer priorities, unresolved feasibility disagreements, and decisions outside your authority with options and a recommendation.
* Raise risks early enough for the team to respond.

Customer and supplier communication

* Confirm customer requirements, requested dates, and delivery arrangements.
* Obtain supplier shipment commitments, tracking information, and missing documents.
* Communicate job progress, outstanding dependencies, and schedule changes clearly.
* Work with the team and customer to agree on achievable recovery dates within established authority.
* Document commitments and confirm completion through customer delivery.
* Keep the President informed through frequent, concise updates and priority discussions.
* Clearly hand off unresolved issues requiring attention after your workday ends.

Project-related support

* Assist with sourcing, purchasing follow-ups, and documentation needed to move assigned jobs forward.
* Coordinate resolution of supplier account or administrative issues affecting project schedules.
* Take on other defined projects as agreed with the President, with priorities adjusted to match available capacity.

How responsibilities fit together

Procurement owns purchasing records and supplier purchasing activity. Receiving owns receiving records and material discrepancies. Production owns its schedule and execution.

You own the integrated job dashboard, cross-team follow-through, and coordination through customer delivery. You’ll work with these team members to identify risks, evaluate their recommendations, and drive next steps.

You’ll have the President’s backing to request timely updates, establish action deadlines with the team, and escalate unresolved commitments. Functional leads remain accountable for execution within their areas.

The President resolves competing customer priorities, significant escalations, and decisions beyond your authority. Customer delivery takes priority over additional internal projects.

What we’re looking for

* Evidence of taking responsibility and seeing work through completion.
* Strong organization across multiple tasks, deadlines, and changing priorities.
* Resourcefulness when information is missing or instructions are incomplete.

**Care Coordinator - Home Care** (Concord / East Bay)

**Schedule**: Full-time, primarily Monday–Friday

**Work Arrangement**: Approximately 80% field-based, 20% office-based

**Reports To**: Operations Manager

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The External Care Coordinator (ECC) is a field-based sales professional responsible for driving new client acquisition throughout the Concord/East Bay territory.

This role focuses on building relationships with healthcare and community referral partners, generating new business opportunities, and guiding prospective clients and families through the sales process—from initial inquiry and in-home consultation to assessment and enrollment.

We're looking for a motivated, relationship-driven individual who enjoys being out in the community, building connections, and helping families find the right care solutions.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Referral Development & Business Generation**

* Build and maintain relationships with healthcare, senior living, and community referral partners.
* Conduct outreach, visits, and presentations to generate qualified referrals.

**2. Initial Inquiry & Pipeline Ownership**

* Respond to inquiries, qualify prospective clients, and schedule consultations.
* Manage timely follow-up and track opportunities through the sales pipeline.

**3. In-Home Consultations, Assessments & Closing**

* Conduct in-home consultations and assessments; recommend services based on client needs.

**Title: Supplier Quality Manager (Quality Systems)**

Location: South San Francisco, CA

Work Type: On-site

Neurona Therapeutics is a clinical stage biotechnology company based in South San Francisco focused on the development of neuronal cell-based therapies for neurological diseases. Our ideal candidate is a self-motivated individual who has a passion for quality. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a growing team, and take part in building an exciting, science-driven company.  
  
**The Role:**  
Neurona is seeking a Supplier Quality Manager who is responsible for the development, implementation, execution, and continuous improvement of Neurona Therapeutics’ Supplier Quality Management program. Reporting to the Director, QA Systems, this individual provides Quality oversight of GxP suppliers, vendors, service providers, contract organizations, and other external partners supporting the development and manufacture of Neurona’s cell therapy products.  
  
The Supplier Quality Manager serves as the Quality Systems subject matter expert for supplier qualification, risk assessment, supplier audits, quality agreements, ongoing performance monitoring, Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs), and periodic requalification. This role partners closely with Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Technical Operations, CMC, Clinical, Information Technology, and other functions to ensure externally provided materials and services meet Neurona requirements and applicable regulatory expectations.  
  
This position combines program ownership with hands-on execution and is expected to build a scalable, risk-based supplier quality program appropriate for a growing clinical-stage cell therapy organization.  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities Include:**  
**Supplier Qualification and Lifecycle Management**

* Own and administer the GxP supplier and vendor qualification program in accordance with applicable Neurona procedures and regulatory requirements.
* Lead the risk-based assessment, qualification, approval, monitoring, requalification, and disqualification of suppliers.
* Review and approve supplier qualification questionnaires and supporting documentation.
* Assess supplier quality systems, technical capabilities, compliance history, and potential risk to product quality, patient safety, data integrity, and regulatory compliance.
* Establish qualification requirements based on supplier type, criticality, intended use, and GxP risk.
* Ensure qualification decisions and supporting documentation are complete, traceable, and inspection ready.
* Maintain supplier qualification status and applicable records in the electronic Quality Management System, including the Approved Vendor List.

**Supplier Audits**

* Support the development and maintenance of a risk-based supplier audit program and audit schedule.
* Support planning, conducting, and documenting on-site, remote, and qualification audits of GxP suppliers and service providers.
* Support regulatory inspections and partner audits involving supplier oversight.

**Supplier Quality Agreements**

* Lead the preparation, review, negotiation, approval, maintenance, and periodic review of GxP Quality Agreements.
* Ensure Quality Agreements clearly define responsibilities for deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change notification, complaints, data integrity, records, audits, subcontracting, regulatory inspections, and other applicable quality requirements.
* Partner with Legal, Supply Chain, CMC, Manufacturing, Clinical, IT, and other functions to establish appropriate provisions.
* Monitor supplier compliance with established Quality Agreement requirements.

**Supplier Performance Management**

* Develop and maintain a risk-based supplier performance monitoring and scorecard program.
* Establish meaningful KPIs and quality metrics for critical suppliers.
* Monitor performance across SCARs, audit findings, deviations and quality events, CAPA effectiveness, change notifications, responsiveness, recurring issues, delivery of quality commitments, and compliance with Quality Agreements.
* Conduct periodic supplier performance reviews and communicate trends, risks, and recommendations to Quality leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Identify suppliers requiring enhanced oversight or formal improvement plans.
* Present supplier quality trends and significant risks during Quality Management Review and other governance forums.

**Supplier Corrective Action and Escalation**

* Lead or coordinate Supplier Corrective Action Requests for significant supplier quality issues.
* Ensure appropriate containment, investigation, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and effectiveness verification.
* Assess supplier investigation and CAPA responses for scientific and technical adequacy.
* Identify recurring issues and escalate significant quality, compliance, supply continuity, or patient-risk concerns.
* Facilitate cross-functional supplier quality escalation meetings, as necessary.
* Partner with suppliers to drive sustainable improvement rather than relying solely on correction or retraining.

**Quality Systems and Compliance**

FNS Training Club is more than a place to work out. We are a private training club built around exceptional coaching, community, culture, and connection.

Our mission is to help everyday athletes become stronger, healthier, and more confident through a personalized approach to training, nutrition, recovery, mindset, and accountability.

We believe every member deserves to feel seen, known, supported, and celebrated. From their first inquiry to their ongoing progress, every interaction is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

As FNS continues to grow, we're looking for a dependable, organized, and people-focused **Member Success & Operations Lead** to support our Chief of Operations and help deliver an exceptional member experience.

The Member Success & Operations Lead is a hands-on position that combines member experience, personalized athlete support, membership inquiry coordination, and daily club operations.

You'll work closely with the Chief of Operations to ensure prospective members are guided through their introductory journey, current members receive ongoing support, and daily operations are completed accurately and efficiently.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with people, has an interest in fitness and wellness, and is comfortable balancing administrative responsibilities with meaningful member interactions.

Browserbase is the complete platform for building and deploying AI agents that browse and interact with the web like humans. Today, Browserbase powers more than 50 million browser sessions each month for over 10,000 customers, including Ramp, DeepMind, Clay, Vercel, and Notion.

We're a Series B startup that's tripled our headcount in 2 years, and we're continuing to grow, fast. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, CRV, and Notable Capital, our team is building on our CEO's founding vision to power the world's best AI tools and help everyone automate the web.

As an Enterprise Technical Customer Success Manager, you’ll own long-term partnerships with customers whose implementations span multiple teams, stakeholders, and business priorities. jobs.title: Learning & Development Manager
jobs.description:
**About Mytra:**

We’re creating an entirely new way to solve the most ubiquitous problem in industry - moving and storing material. We’re applying robotics and distributed software to create a new class of product for this $1T market. We’re focused on the supply chain industry first. The industry is in a massive bind with the continued growth of e-commerce, sharp rise in costs, and supply chain disruptions. What has been a “sleepy” industry for decades is now at the epicenter of sustaining the global economy.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Learning & Development Lead at Mytra, you will join our People team during a period of rapid scaling. You will build Mytra’s first dedicated learning function: programs that grow our employees and leaders, keep Mytra safe and compliant, and give our customers the training they need to run our system. We need a hands-on, systems-minded builder to help us turn learning into a driver of capability and growth.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

* **Build a foundational learning function.** Set structured standards for how training is designed and delivered at Mytra, create learning pathways mapped to the Mytra Level Matrix, and develop train-the-trainer programs to scale expertise across teams
* **Own employee development.** Partner with the People team on new hire orientation and onboarding, run feedback training, and design ongoing learning programs and stipends
* **Run leadership development programs.** Partner with the Head of People to curate programs for our leaders, including Enneagram sessions and people manager training. Own the operations behind them: managing external coaches and vendors, managing attendees and enrollment, and supporting facilitators with content grounded in adult learning principles
* **Drive customer enablement.** Work with Deployment, Sustainment, Customer Operations and Safety so customers have the right training and a clean handoff after deployment, covering on-the-job training, processes, escalations and system safety
* **Build on-the-job training.** Partner with Manufacturing, Safety and Customer Operations to develop critical training that ramps internal capability, including effective train-the-trainer programs for technical and frontline teams
* **Own the LMS and training compliance.** Manage our LMS for all Mytra training, and partner cross-functionally to deliver 100% compliance on safety, security and HR-related training

**Ideal Candidates**
--------------------

* Have proven experience designing and scaling learning programs across employee, leadership and technical or operational training
* Have deep expertise in adult learning principles and instructional design, with a track record of turning them into practical, engaging content
* Have built learning structures from the ground up, including standards, pathways and measurement, ideally in a fast-growing company
* Have built train-the-trainer and on-the-job programs in hardware, manufacturing or field-based environments
* Have run the operations of learning programs: LMS administration, compliance tracking, and managing external coaches and vendors
* Operate with high independence: define the approach for ambiguous initiatives, make tradeoffs across operational and business needs, and build practices adopted well beyond your own team
* Demonstrate our values: build trust across functions, ask why to find the real capability gap, and build programs that last while moving quickly

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* Customer training or enablement experience for complex hardware or software products
* Enneagram certification

**A Final Note:**
-----------------

If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t check every box. At Mytra, we build bots, but we hire humans. We value thoughtful challengers who communicate with clarity and respect, and we’re lifelong learners committed to getting better every day. We move fast, learn faster, and show up for each other under pressure. The best outcomes come from diverse perspectives working together to build something meaningful and built to last

**Benefits Include:**
---------------------

* Competitive compensation and equity grants at a high-growth company backed by top-tier VCs
* Fully subsidized health coverage, including medical (baseline plans), dental, and vision for employees and dependents
* 401(k) plans and employer-subsidized life insurance
* Fully subsidized lunch and snacks at HQ—we eat and share stories together at the “long” table
* Generous PTO and company-paid holidays, including one week over the winter break so everyone can recharge together
* Voluntary pet insurance, Voluntary Life Insurance, Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity
* Fully subsidized tax advisory services and education to help you understand your equity
* Commuter benefits, including a up to $150 monthly commuter benefit
* Lively, modern combined office and lab space where we rapidly iterate through design, build, and test phases
* Fully equipped onsite gym and showers at headquarters

**Pay Notice**
--------------

Compensation for this position will be set based on the candidate's experience level and location. The posted salary band is applicable only to the San Francisco Bay Area and is subject to change.

***This role requires on-site presence at our Brisbane, CA headquarters, for close collaboration with the other teams.***

jobs.title: Associate, Brand Deals Growth Strategy (3P Enablement), YouTube
jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; San Bruno, CA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in product marketing, go-to-market strategy, business operations, sales enablement, or digital agency strategy within the technology or digital media sectors.
* Experience analyzing data (using spreadsheets or SQL) to extract business insights and translate metrics into structured, external-facing business narratives.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 4 years of experience in product marketing, go-to-market strategy, business operations, sales enablement, or digital agency strategy.
* Experience writing and design-packaging B2B sales claims, advertiser case studies, or structured partner training curriculums.
* Experience designing, launching, or administering partner programs (e.g., agency tiering, partner certifications, or brand badging programs).
* Experience with the creator economy, Influencer Marketing Agencies (IMAs), or third-party digital advertising landscapes.

**About the job**
-----------------

Commercial & Segment Activation (CSA) sits at the heart of YouTube Go-To-Market Operations (GTMO), driving the global commercial strategy, partner segmentation, and go-to-market execution that power YouTube's creator and partner ecosystem.  
  
Within CSA, the Brand Deals team leads the end-to-end commercial strategy to capture YouTube's fair share of the rapidly expanding creator sponsorships and influencer marketing ecosystem. Working at the intersection of Creators, Brands, Influencer Marketing Agencies (IMAs), and cross-functional Product and Sales teams, we build the commercial engines, ecosystem partnerships, and go-to-market playbooks that enable creators to diversify and grow their earnings while delivering measurable ROI for advertisers on YouTube.

As an Associate on the Brand Deals Growth Strategy team (3P Enablement), you are the storyteller and commercial activator of the team. Your job is to make sure the market knows exactly how to buy, sell, and win with YouTube Brand Deals.

You will work on the frontline of market adoption: converting raw campaign data into powerful, external-facing advertiser claims and case studies and working closely with the Regional Go-To-Market (RGTM) team to understand local market nuances and deploy custom playbooks on "what it takes to win" in key regions.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $124000 - $177000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Partner closely with regional GTM leads across AMER, EMEA, and APAC to identify localized market barriers, advertiser behavior, and competitive dynamics.
* Act as the central intake lead, synthesizing feedback to identify what resources, playbooks, or product features are needed to win local market share.
* Extract performance metrics from commercial pilots (including hybrid/shopping campaigns and new formats like Posts) to author compelling, data-backed advertiser claims and ROI benchmarks.
* Collaborate with Marketing and Sales teams to write and publish flagship external case studies that mathematically prove YouTube's full-funnel creator sponsorship value.
* Author comprehensive training curriculums, pitch decks, FAQs, and global GTM playbooks to upskill frontline sales teams and 3P partners. Maintain the central enablement repository, tracking training completion and pipeline velocity to report on regional GTM readiness.
