jobs.title: Sales Strategy and Operations, Senior Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Browserbase**
---------------------

Browserbase is the complete platform for building and deploying AI agents that browse and interact with the web like humans. With a single API key, developers can enable agents to search and retrieve information, fill out forms, and take action across websites. Today, Browserbase powers more than 50 million browser sessions each month for over 10,000 customers, including Ramp, DeepMind, Clay, Vercel, and Notion.

We're a Series B startup that's tripled our headcount in 2 years, and we're continuing to grow, fast. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, CRV, and Notable Capital, our team is building on our CEO's founding vision to power the world's best AI tools and help everyone automate the web.

**About the role**
------------------

This is the founding hire on the Revenue Operations team! We’re pretty excited about it. It’s also the first one focused squarely on sales strategy and analytics, so you should have a background in Sales Ops. You will report to and work in close partnership with our RevOps Lead, along with our Head of Sales, Head of Growth, Head of Finance, AEs, and TCSMs. This role is based in San Francisco where the full team is, and we are open to New York for the right candidate.

At Browserbase, we sell a usage-based product through two motions: a self-serve funnel that thousands of developers enter on their own, and an enterprise sales team that turns the best of those (and fresh outbound accounts) into large, expanding deals. This role would have to understand our revenue model to help impact strategic sales decisions like segmenting, forecasting, and compensation.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Segmentation analysis:** Run the closed-won and expansion analysis that tells us how we should be carving the market and strategize the best way to ensure coverage, account assignment, and quota.
* **Quota and capacity modeling.** Build the capacity models, quota scenarios, and SDR target math that Sales leadership and Finance make decisions from. Model the levers before we pull them and bring them, with an opinion, to the team.
* **Forecast modeling and inspection:** Build and maintain the forecast model, prep the weekly call, inspect the deals behind the number, and flag where it is likely wrong before anyone else notices. You are our eyes and ears and we rely on you to make sure the data is correct.
* **Funnel and pipeline analytics:** Partner with our team on filling in the funnel from self-serve signup to PQL to SQO to closed-won to expansion. Surface the conversion points worth fixing, jump in with recommendations, and help us get creative on moving the number. We’ve worked with RevOps people before who stay squarely out of the strategic decisions and work, this job isn’t it! We want you excited by the problems and to partner on solving them.
* **Systems troubleshooting.** Understand the systems generating our numbers (HubSpot, Snowflake, Stripe, product data) well enough to triage them.
* **Market sizing and targeting.** Use enrichment tooling to size segments, build target account lists, and support outbound planning.
* **Deal desk support.** Help on pricing approvals and deal structure as volume grows. Secondary to everything above, but part of the job.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 3 to 5 years in sales operations, revenue operations, sales strategy, or GTM strategy and operations at a B2B SaaS or developer tools company. A consulting or finance background with at least two years in an operating seat also works.
* Real analytical chops. You can build a segmentation analysis, a capacity model, and a forecast, and you know which one the question calls for. SQL or equivalent, plus actual modeling, not just pivot tables.
* You can take a defined piece of a larger problem and run it to a real answer without needing to own the whole thing.
* Great collaboration with Sales. Your customers at Browserbase will be internal so that means working well with AEs and jamming on strategic reports with the Head of Sales.
* Hands-on with HubSpot or Salesforce. You know the objects, the reporting layer, and where the data actually comes from.
* You have worked on a forecast before and understand what makes one wrong.
* Genuine AI tooling fluency. You use Claude, Codex, or similar to write queries, prototype internal tools, and move faster. When building something yourself is the fastest path, you build it.
* Low ego, high ownership. We are small and the job will definitely change.

**Nice to haves**
-----------------

* Usage-based or consumption pricing experience.
* Experience supporting both self-serve and enterprise motions, and an instinct for how they should reinforce each other.
* Clay, Amplemarket, Outreach, or similar for enrichment, TAM building, and outbound tooling.
* Quota and comp plan design experience. We are not hiring a dedicated comp analyst, but knowing how plans behave is valuable.
* Snowflake, dbt, or a BI tool like Hex, Looker, or Tableau.
* Deal desk or CPQ exposure.
* You have been an early ops hire before and know what breaks beyond a Series B.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive salary + meaningful early-stage equity
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
* 401(k)
* Daily catered lunches with a fully-stocked kitchen
* Beautiful office in downtown San Francisco
* All the AI tools + credits you want
* Regular team offsites and company events

Base Compensation

$120,000 - $160,000 USD

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

jobs.description:
**Compliance / Training Specialist**  
**Yogurtland | Field-Based Position**  
**Location:** Northern & Southern California

**About the Opportunity**

Yogurtland is seeking a detail-oriented Compliance / Training Specialist who is passionate about food safety, operational excellence, and helping store teams succeed.

This role combines objective store evaluations with practical, hands-on training. You will visit franchise locations, assess execution against Yogurtland standards, identify opportunities for improvement, and help franchisees, managers, and team members understand how to correct issues and sustain results.

The ideal candidate can hold teams accountable while building respectful, productive relationships. You should be comfortable explaining the “why” behind a standard, addressing difficult conversations professionally, and following through until corrective actions are verified.

**What You’ll Do**

**Store Compliance and Brand Standards**

* Conduct thorough, objective audits of assigned locations, evaluating food safety, sanitation, product quality, equipment, facility conditions, guest experience, and brand standards.
* Verify actual store conditions through direct observation, measurements, records, and required photographs.
* Evaluate frozen yogurt and topping quality, including freshness, taste, texture, temperature controls, and product testing using approved procedures.
* Apply audit standards and severity classifications consistently across all locations.
* Prepare accurate, timely reports with clear findings, supporting evidence, and required corrective actions.
* Promptly address and escalate serious food safety, employee or guest safety, product integrity, and repeated compliance concerns.

**Training and Store Team Development**

* Provide hands-on instruction to franchisees, managers, and team members on approved operating procedures and brand expectations.
* Reinforce proper food handling, allergen controls, sanitation, product preparation, quality checks, and equipment care.
* Explain audit findings clearly and demonstrate corrective practices when appropriate.
* Identify gaps in knowledge or execution and recommend targeted training to Operations leadership.
* Partner with Franchise Business Consultants and Operations to support lasting improvements and consistent communication.
* Participate in team training and audit calibration exercises to ensure standards are interpreted and applied consistently.

**Corrective Action and Follow-Through**

* Conduct professional closing conversations that clarify findings, priorities, next steps, and follow-up expectations.
* Track outstanding corrective actions and verify completion through approved documentation or follow-up visits.
* Identify recurring issues and escalate unresolved concerns through the appropriate Operations channels.
* Maintain objective audit results while documenting corrections and training provided during the visit.
* Share trends and recommendations that can improve training, operating procedures, and systemwide execution.

**Field Planning and Reporting**

* Plan efficient travel routes and visit schedules to support consistent territory coverage.
* Maintain a regular field presence, with five days per week in stores except for approved or extenuating circumstances.
* Target a minimum of two completed audits per field day when routing and circumstances reasonably permit, while maintaining thorough evaluations.
* Keep audit documentation, corrective-action tracking, and leadership updates current.
* Protect confidential franchisee, employee, and business information.

**What You Bring**

* Experience in restaurant operations, preferably within quick-service, fast-casual, or franchise environments.
* A strong understanding of food safety, sanitation, product quality, and store operating standards.
* Experience coaching or training restaurant managers and team members.
* Strong observation, documentation, organization, and follow-through skills.
* The ability to communicate expectations clearly and handle disagreement calmly and professionally.
* Sound judgment and the ability to remain fair, consistent, and objective.
* Comfort using digital audit platforms, mobile devices, reporting tools, and spreadsheets.
* The ability to manage an assigned territory independently and travel regularly to store locations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience conducting operational audits, food safety inspections, or brand compliance evaluations.
* Experience supporting multiple locations or working directly with franchisees.
* Current food protection manager certification, such as ServSafe or an equivalent credential.
* Experience with frozen dessert operations or related foodservice equipment.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means accurate audits, clear and useful training, timely corrective-action closure, fewer repeat findings, and stronger execution across assigned stores. We value both accountability and the ability to help teams understand and consistently meet expectations.

**How to Apply**

Submit your resume to arlo.mcguire@yogurtland.com . Please highlight your experience in restaurant operations, compliance, food safety, and team training and your location.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year

jobs.description:
**Position Title: Onboarding Specialist**

**Location: Remote**

**Who We Are:**

As Nelson Mandela said, “Sport has the power to change the world. It has the power to inspire. It has the power to unite people in a way that little else does.”

At LeagueApps, we agree. Mission-driven at our core, every member of our team is committed to a world where all kids and communities can benefit from youth sports. We help leading youth sports organizations operate, engage, and win with the industry's most comprehensive youth sports management platform. We power thousands of clubs, camps, tournaments, and leagues, and reach millions of participants each day.

Beyond our technology, we’re focused on developing the industry’s youth sports leaders through our NextUp: Youth Sports Management Community—providing them with opportunities for professional development and networking. Through events, content, and leadership development programming, we’re taking youth sports management to the next level. Through our FundPlay program, we provide support to sports-based youth development organizations that bring sports experiences to hundreds of thousands of underserved kids and communities. We are also founding members and leaders of the PLAY Sports Coalition, a group that advocates for youth sports at the national level.

**Role Mission:**  
  
The **Onboarding Specialist** owns each new partner’s Year 1 onboarding experience, picking up from Sales and guiding them through the full activation process to ensure they find value in our platform quickly and confidently. In this role, you will manage all phases of partner onboarding—from the kickoff call through transacting, platform training, and activation of every planned Year 1 expected program—across a diverse portfolio of new accounts. A partner’s first program launch is a major milestone, but onboarding is complete only when every planned Year 1 program is closed and the partner graduates to their long-term LeagueApps team. You will be responsible for driving strong activation rates across your book of business while maintaining an efficient and consistent approach to every partner launch. Your ability to build trust, set clear expectations, and keep onboardings on track will be the key to your success in this role.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Manage all phases of partner onboarding, launch, and activation across your assigned portfolio, including:
  + Initial Kickoff Calls
  + Program Builds and Activations
  + Platform Training Sessions and Enablement
  + Handoff Calls
* Conduct 45–60 minute 1:1 training sessions with new partners, guiding them through platform setup and the capabilities most relevant to their organization, from core features to newer functionality being released.
* Maintain an active book of business of onboarding partners, managing multiple launches simultaneously with consistency and care.
* Drive strong activation rates of new partner EARR sold through timely, consistent follow-up and proactive partner engagement, including continued monitoring of upcoming Year 1 launches after a partner begins transacting.

* Complete internal pre-kickoff preparation, including reviewing Salesforce Launch Handoffs, confirming gateway setup, and building partner-specific onboarding decks.
* Perform consistent follow-up with partners and never end a call with an unactivated partner without the next meeting scheduled.
* Triage and route partner issues appropriately—escalating troubleshooting, member management, and gateway items to the Support team via warm handoffs.
* Spot-check partner accounts in the LeagueApps management console and Gainsight to confirm accuracy of rates, org details, and launch status.
* Maintain accurate records in Gainsight, keeping all launch details, ongoing programs, onboarding CTAs, and session notes up to date.
* Prioritize your book of business strategically, allocating time based on partner EARR, responsiveness, and estimated transacting start date.
* Set clear boundaries with partners around scheduling, scope of work, and timelines to ensure efficient onboarding and protect your capacity.
* Collaborate with Sales Consultants on smooth handoffs and loop in your manager when partner escalations or boundary issues arise.

* Confirm handoff readiness before any transition.
* Schedule and lead the handoff call, preparing the receiving CSM, Account Manager, or Support team with partner history, call recordings, wins, risks, and open items.
* For accounts under $10K, send the graduation follow-up and introduce LeagueApps Support as the partner’s primary resource.
* Be the face of LeagueApps to new partners throughout their first year on the platform!

**Who You Are:**

* Highly organized and self-motivated, with excellent time management skills and the ability to manage a high-volume workload independently.

**Finance and Operations Manager**

**Position Summary**

Department: Operations

Reports to: Executive Director

**About Mothers Out Front**

Mothers Out Front builds our power as mothers to ensure a livable climate for all children. We are growing a multi-racial, cross-class, intergenerational movement of mothers, grandmothers, and caregivers dedicated to convincing elected officials and business leaders to work for a swift, complete, and just transition away from fossil fuels to clean and renewable energy. We know that mothers have an important role to play in the climate justice movement, and, when it comes to protecting children, mothers are an unstoppable force for change. Our goal is simple: to enable mothers to take active leadership in climate justice work by providing the structure, training, and tools for them to work together and win campaigns in their communities, cities, and states.

**About the Role**

The Finance and Operations Manager oversees the day-to-day administrative, human resources, and financial operations that keep our organization healthy and compliant. Working closely with our Executive Director, CFO, and accountant, this person makes sure our systems, people, and money are well managed so our team can focus on our mission. The role suits an organized, detail-oriented generalist who enjoys building processes and moving between many kinds of work.

**What You’ll Do**

**Administration and Operations**

* Administer our operations tech stack, including Google Drive, project management, password management, and device management systems, and maintain strong data security practices.
* Manage contracts, insurance policies, and renewals.
* Manage our virtual office including equipment, mailbox, and subscriptions or vendor relationships.

**Financial Management**

* Support the monthly and year-end close by making sure transactions and receipts are recorded accurately and on time.

* Serve as a first point of contact for employee questions and concerns, handling sensitive matters with discretion.

* Track and manage state and federal nonprofit reporting requirements and deadlines, including charitable registrations, annual reports, and lobbying disclosures.
* Help identify and reduce organizational risk, including through insurance coverage and internal controls.

**What You Will Need**

* **Experience:** The Finance and Operations Manager will have at least 6 years of experience in nonprofit operations, finance, or administration, preferably in a nonprofit, advocacy, or political organization. Experience in a small organization where you covered several functions is a plus.

Familiarity with restricted grants, grant reporting, and allocating spending across 501(c)(3) and 501(c)(4) entities is highly desirable.
* **Human Resources:** Working knowledge of HR administration, including recruiting, onboarding, benefits, payroll processing, and personnel records. Experience in a unionized workplace or with a collective bargaining agreement is a plus.

Join our team at NCD, a top-tier insurance provider, consisting of a unique and eclectic group of winners, nerds, and gamers who balance a fun, kind, and thoughtful approach to life with an unwavering commitment to unparalleled member satisfaction. Our ecosystem is rooted in our five core values: Relentless Positivity, Growth Obsessed, Get it Done, Helpful Spirit, and Solution Driven.

We are not just coworkers, but a community, working tirelessly towards 'Spreading the Smile' to our members, agents, and each other. NCD is at the forefront of dental and vision insurance, in partnership with our carrier partners MetLife, VSP, and Zurich. Our continuous growth is a testament to our commitment to delivering outstanding agent and customer satisfaction.

If you are ready to win each day, are eager to grow, and aspire to contribute to an organization that is setting the pace in the industry, then we are looking for you. Together, let’s drive change and take NCD to new heights. Join us and become a vital part of our success story as we continue to transform lives and 'Spread the Smile.

**Summary:**

The Operations Coordinator plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy, efficiency, and timeliness of agent commissions, billing, and payment processes. This position supports the daily execution and continuous improvement of the company’s core operational workflows.  
  
This individual will collaborate closely with the Operations, Sales, and Finance teams to ensure that agent incentive payouts, agent commissions, and client billing, are processed accurately and on schedule. The role requires strong attention to detail, comfort working with data, and the ability to maintain organized documentation and clear communication across departments.  
  
The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys working in a fast-moving, positive environment and takes pride in delivering high-quality, consistent results. This role is a great opportunity for someone eager to learn, grow, and contribute to a team that values collaboration, innovation, and operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Commissions**

* Prepare and process agent commission payouts accurately and on schedule, in line with company policy
* Maintain the payout calendar, tracking timelines, approvals, and dependencies
* Validate data from CRM and financial systems to ensure accuracy and consistency
* Reconcile payments against sales and billing records, and resolve discrepancies promptly
* Run recurring scrubs to catch duplicates, setup errors, and misaligned data before payouts run
* Partner with Sales Operations on commission setup best practices
* Improve reporting, automation, and documentation

**Incentive Programs**

* Partner with Sales Operations on the launch and delivery of agent incentive programs
* Deliver data pulls and tracking to measure program results all varying by partner and product
* Process incentive payouts accurately and on time
* Research and resolve questions and disputes about results and payouts
* Maintain an incentive calendar and clear records for every program
* Standardize templates and documentation so new programs launch smoothly

**Operations Support & Reporting**

* Maintain data accuracy and consistency across CRM systems and operational databases.
* Track, monitor, and report on key metrics related to incentives, billing performance, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure clear communication and alignment on processes.
* Provide administrative and analytical support for department initiatives, special projects, and process improvement efforts.

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in operations, commissions, or financial administration (insurance or financial services experience preferred).
* Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to identify and correct numerical or data inconsistencies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; proficient in Microsoft Excel (formulas, pivot tables, lookups).
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills; able to collaborate effectively across teams.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* High level of integrity, discretion, and professionalism when handling sensitive financial information.
* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business, or a related field preferred (or equivalent experience).

**NCD Benefits**

* Company-paid health, dental, life, and disability insurance
* 401(k) with employer match
* Opportunity for professional development
* Work from home allowance and support
* Positive work environment
* Remote, office-based flexibility within the United States of America

**Equal Opportunity**

NCD is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe our differences make us stronger and help us better serve our members, agents, partners, and each other.

**About Claim Warriors**

Claim Warriors (www.claimwarriors.com) is a rapidly growing residential and commercial insurance public adjusting firm, operating across 18 states and expanding into new markets. We advocate for property owners facing denied, underpaid, and complex insurance claims, combining claims expertise, detailed documentation, and persistent negotiation to help clients secure the settlements they deserve.

In just two years, we have grown to more than 70 team members. We are looking for an organized, decisive Operations Manager to strengthen our processes, hold teams accountable, and help scale our claims operations.

**About the Role**

You will oversee operations after marketing and sales, taking ownership of how claims move from client onboarding through inspections, estimates, negotiations, attorney referrals when necessary, and payment.

This role requires a strong understanding of the full property insurance claim lifecycle. Your primary focus will be managing and scaling onboarding and claims workflows, reducing turnaround times, and ensuring every file has an accountable owner and a clear next step.

You will work closely with our Claims Manager, Claim Consultants, Inspection Dispatcher, in-house and outsourced inspectors, attorney partners, Customer Support team, and three Virtual Project Managers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Onboarding & File Readiness**

* Manage and scale the onboarding process as claim volume grows.
* Ensure each file contains the required agreements, policies, carrier correspondence, photographs, payment information, and supporting documentation.
* Establish clear handoffs between sales, onboarding, inspections, and claims teams.
* Identify missing information early and ensure it is obtained promptly.
* Set expectations for onboarding turnaround times and hold the team accountable for meeting them.

**Inspections & Dispatch**

* Oversee inspection scheduling and completion through our Inspection Dispatcher.
* Coordinate assignments and capacity across in-house inspectors and outsourced inspection partners.
* Ensure inspections produce complete, timely photographs, reports, and supporting documentation.
* Resolve scheduling delays, missed appointments, and quality issues that could slow claim progression.

**Estimates, Negotiations & Claim Progression**

* Manage estimating and negotiation workflows with our Claims Manager and in-house Claim Consultants.
* Maintain visibility into every active file, including its status, owner, next action, and deadlines.
* Establish and monitor turnaround expectations from onboarding through inspection, estimating, and negotiation.
* Hold teams accountable for timely follow-up, accurate documentation, and consistent progress.
* Identify stalled files, resolve bottlenecks, and escalate issues when necessary.
* Track settlement and payment milestones through completion.

**Attorney Network Coordination**

**Department Name: Office of the Provost**

**Position Reports To: Vice Provost of Academic Operations**

**FLSA STATUS: Salaried**

**Benefits:** The University's comprehensive benefits program.

**Location:** Remote; some travel may be required for in-person collaboration and campus events.

**Days & Hours:** Standard work schedule is Monday through Friday, 37.5 hours per week, generally 9am – 5:30pm PST but can be adjusted and/or staggered to support team coverage across the team’s coverage window; flexible schedule may require some evening and weekend hours during peak periods or to handle escalations.

**BASIC FUNCTION AND SCOPE OF JOB:**

Build, stabilize, and lead GGU One’s student support operation. Manage the Navigator team (Navigators are Golden Gate University’s first contact for all student inquiries), establish dependable coverage and follow-up, improve service quality, and lead implementation of the agreed operating model and roadmap in partnership with university departments and IT.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* **Team Leadership & Development:** Hire, onboard, supervise, coach, and evaluate the GGU One Navigator team. Establish clear responsibilities and ongoing training.
* **Daily Operations & Coverage:** Own staffing schedules, absence coverage, queue monitoring, callback oversight, and daily priorities across phone and email support. Designate backup operational coverage during planned and unplanned absences.
* **Service Implementation & Improvement:** Lead execution of the approved GGU One operating model and roadmap, translating pilot findings into sustainable workflows, staffing practices, and service improvements.
* **Vision & Service Evolution:** Shape the long-term vision for GGU One in partnership with university leadership. Evaluate opportunities to improve student support through AI, self-service, and additional channels such as chat and text, prioritizing student needs, service quality, and operational readiness.
* **Case Ownership & Tier 2 Follow-Through:** Establish clear ownership, response expectations, and escalation procedures with university departments. Monitor unresolved and overdue inquiries, address stalled handoffs, and ensure students receive updates through resolution.
* **Knowledge & Guidance:** Coordinate with departmental subject-matter experts to maintain accurate, approved Navigator resources. Establish content owners and a process for addressing gaps, conflicting guidance, and policy changes.
* **Quality Assurance & Training:** Review call recordings, email interactions, and case documentation. Provide timely coaching and targeted training on accuracy, empathy, identity verification, escalation, and follow-up.
* **Technology & Workflow Coordination:** Partner with IT and Salesforce administrators to improve inquiry management and support the transition from interim Teams and tracker workflows to the approved Salesforce-based approach. Define operational requirements, lead user testing, and prepare the team to adopt new workflows, while technical teams own system configuration and integrations.
* **Reporting & Capacity Planning:** Produce regular reporting on demand, answering, callbacks, resolution, unresolved work, and quality. Validate metric definitions and data accuracy and recommend staffing adjustments as demand and service scope evolve.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* **Education Requirement:** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Higher Education, or any other related field from an accredited college or university.
* **Years of Experience:** 5+ years of relevant service-operations experience, including direct supervision of a customer support, contact center, or higher education student-services team.
* **Operational Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to build or stabilize an evolving service operation, establish workflows, manage queue coverage, and lead teams through process and technology changes.
* **Contact Center Management:** Experience with staffing and shift scheduling, quality assurance scorecards, coaching, case management/ticketing systems, and operational reporting.
* **Cross-Departmental Collaboration:** Ability to establish accountability, establish and monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and resolve student service issues across departments, including teams outside the role’s direct reporting line.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Working knowledge of CRM and contact-center tools (ideally Salesforce Education Cloud/Service Cloud), with experience partnering with IT/technical teams on operational implementations.

  + Excellent communication, leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

  + Proven experience leading a diverse team with varied expertise, including coaching, training, and employee development.
  + Ability to compile and synthesize data from multiple sources into reports and presentations for leadership.
  + Self-directed and able to work effectively with minimal supervision.

**Description**
---------------

Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.

**Make an impact — from near or far**

At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. Employees must reside in, and work from, one of the above approved states.

**The opportunity**

The AI Delivery and Operations Lead reports directly to the Assistant Vice President of AI Engineering and leads how SNHU's AI Engineering team plans, coordinates and delivers its work. AI Engineering builds AI software, from LLM applications and agents to the shared platform they run on, in small teams called pods; each pod pairs AI Engineering with the business team that owns the problem. Reporting to the AVP, AI Engineering, the Lead owns the team's operating rhythm, leads delivery of assigned pod initiatives from intake to production, and keeps goals, decisions, risks, and dependencies visible to pods, leadership, and the university IT, security, and AI governance teams that pod work depends on.

  
  

This is a player-coach role. The Lead starts as an individual contributor and may build a small delivery team as the number of pods grows; engineers keep their own reporting lines. Success depends on the ability to create clarity from ambiguity, exercise sound judgment, influence without direct authority, and follow work through to outcomes. The role calls for enough AI and software fluency to follow engineering trade-offs and question them, but does not require building AI systems.

  
  

You will work 100% remotely in this role. #LI-Remote

  
  
  

**What You'll Do:**

  
  

* **Operating rhythm:** Own the day-to-day operating rhythm of AI Engineering, including weekly syncs, demos, retrospectives, leadership reviews, planning cycles, and decision and action logs, using written and automated updates in place of meetings where possible, so that priorities, decisions, and dependencies stay visible and moving.

* **Pod delivery plans:** Lead delivery of assigned priority pod initiatives from intake and scoping through build and launch, building integrated plans with clear scope, milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, and success measures across pods, university IT, the AI governance team, and business teams.

* 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in program, project, technology delivery, or operations management in a complex, cross-functional environment, including experience delivering technology-enabled initiatives such as enterprise software, data and analytics, automation, or AI.
* Bachelor's degree in business, information systems, computer science, or a related field.

* Strong knowledge of software delivery methods, including Agile and hybrid approaches, release planning, risk and dependency management, and goal frameworks such as OKRs.

jobs.description:
Cofactr is on a mission to empower those who get the critical work done. We're bridging the gaps left by traditional supply chain management solutions, creating a seamless link between Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) through our innovative BOM to Build Platform, specifically tailored for hardware innovators. Our platform revolutionizes the technical hardware supply chain by ensuring it is precise, efficient, and effortlessly manageable. As a proud member of the Y Combinator W22 cohort, we've seen our revenue grow consistently, supported by substantial venture funding from esteemed VCs, including Bain Capital Ventures, including our most recent Series A capital raise of $17.2M.

  

**The Team**

The Cofactr team is innovative, creative, and collaborative, with diverse professional backgrounds and a passion for solving big problems. We’re hiring team members who are energized by the opportunity to make one of the most complex challenges in the world, the global electronics supply chain, into a scalable and intuitive tool. We value transparency and trust among our team and translate this approach into our evolving product.

  

**The Role**

The Sr. Onboarding Project Specialist owns the project management of every new Cofactr customer onboarding, from the moment Sales hands off a closed deal (starting at the end of the sales cycle) through the CSM-led enablement sessions that get the customer's team using the platform. You will run several onboardings at once, each with its own timeline, stakeholders, and configuration requirements, and keep every one of them moving. The value of this role is improving time to value for every new customer while giving them an excellent onboarding experience and making sure they achieve the outcomes they came to Cofactr for. You will get customers from signed contract to configured, enabled, and placing orders faster, without cutting corners on the setup or the relationship.

You are the coordinator between Sales, Customer Success, and the customer. You review what Sales captured in discovery, close the gaps before configuration starts, drive account setup to completion, and line up the enablement sessions our CSMs lead. Your work lets CSMs spend their time on enablement and account growth instead of logistics, and it gets customers to their first purchase (major value milestone) faster. This role requires ***operational rigor***, a **project management mindset**, **strong communication skills**, **cross functional relationship building**, and the discipline to track many concurrent projects without letting one stall.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Sales-to-CS Handoff:** Own the handoff for every new customer. Review the configuration discovery and intake materials from Sales, identify missing requirements, and resolve open questions with Sales and the customer before work begins. Close the knowledge gap.
* **Onboarding Project Management:** Run each onboarding as a project with a defined plan, milestones, owners, and target dates. Track status across all active onboardings and flag risks early.
* **Account Configuration:** Coordinate and complete account setup based on the reviewed requirements, partnering with Support, Product, and Engineering where needs go beyond standard setup.
* **Setup Review:** Lead the account setup review with the customer's main point of contact to confirm the configuration is right before enablement begins.
* **Enablement Coordination:** Schedule and prepare CSM-led enablement sessions and office hours, including attendees, agendas, and customer pre-work, so the CSM can focus on delivering the session and the customer arrives ready.
* **Customer Communication:** Keep customers informed and accountable throughout onboarding with clear next steps, timelines, and recaps.
* **Documentation and Systems:** Keep onboarding records current in our systems (Notion, Salesforce, Pylon) so Sales, CS, and leadership can see where every customer stands.
* **Process Improvement:** Work with CS leadership to refine onboarding playbooks, intake forms, checklists, and templates as volume grows.
* **Metrics and Reporting:** Track onboarding metrics such as time from close to configuration complete, time to first enablement session, time to first purchase, and number of onboardings in flight, and use them to find and remove delays.

### **What We're Looking For**

* **Experience:** 4+ years in customer onboarding, implementation, or project management in a B2B SaaS or technology environment.

  + Extra credit for supply chain, procurement, or hardware/manufacturing industry experience
* **Extreme Ownership:** You treat every onboarding as your own from handoff to enablement, and when something stalls, you find the blocker, pull in the right people, and see it through to resolution.
* **Concurrent Project Management:** A track record of running multiple customer projects at once, each with its own timeline, stakeholders, and milestones.
* **Organization and Follow-Through:** You keep a clean tracker, run tight meetings, and close loops without being reminded.
* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal communication with customers and internal teams, including the ability to push for decisions and hold stakeholders to dates.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Comfortable learning and configuring SaaS platforms, and able to diagnose a setup issue well enough to route it to the right person.
* **Tech Stack Experience:** Familiarity with tools like SFDC, Pylon, Notion, Gainsight, or Metabase; ability to quickly learn new platforms.
* **AI Literacy:** Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude in your daily work, for example to draft customer communications, summarize calls, build trackers, or automate repetitive steps, and the curiosity to find new ways to apply them to onboarding.
* **Adaptability:** Comfortable in an early-stage environment where processes are still being built.

Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. We’re a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers shaping the future of Dropbox and, in turn, the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you.

The Dropbox Business Strategy & Operations team unlocks the company's full potential by driving strategic initiatives and promoting operational excellence. We combine analytical rigor with creative problem-solving to tackle Dropbox’s biggest opportunities and challenges across all business functions. Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Finance, we translate our strategic vision into actionable plans that foster growth, optimize performance, and facilitate informed decision-making. Our work shapes the future of Dropbox by leading cross-functional business planning, developing insights that guide corporate and business unit strategies, creating systems and processes that power scalable success. If you're passionate about strategic thinking, solving complex problems, and making an impact through collaboration, join our Business Strategy & Operations team.

### **Virtual First**

Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. Virtual First is built to provide the same access to opportunity, growth, and impact for everyone, regardless of location.

This role requires travel to offsites and various other team gatherings (approximately 5-10% of the year or 2-3 days per quarter). We provide advance notice when possible and encourage candidates to discuss any accommodation needs during the interview process.

AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.

* **Experimentation:** You explore new AI capabilities and apply them to improve workflows within approved tools and practices.
* **Leverage:** You use AI to enhance thinking, improve efficiency, and increase your impact and your team’s.
* **Learning:** You stay current on emerging AI tools and trends, continuously build your skills, and share what you learn with others.

Together, these behaviors help build a workforce where technology amplifies human judgment, creativity, and impact.

As Project Manager, you'll coordinate training development projects from initial planning through final delivery, working closely with our Instructional Systems Design, Content Development, and Content Production teams.

You'll manage schedules, budgets, resources, Smartsheet workflows, and critical project logistics while maintaining clear communication with internal teams, outside subject matter experts, and customer stakeholders.

We're looking for someone who supports our teams in tracking and reporting progress, anticipating challenges and risks, taking initiative to manage change, and creating the structure needed to keep projects moving.

This position reports to our VP of Operations.

* Develop and manage comprehensive project plans, schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams, external subject matter experts, contractors, and project stakeholders.

* Track budgets, resource utilization, project expenses, and cost variances.
* Coordinate project logistics for production and content capture activities, including travel arrangements, facilities, scheduling, and external participants.
* Identify project risks, scheduling conflicts, resource constraints, and potential delays before they affect delivery.
* Prepare accurate project reports and maintain clear communication with leadership and customer stakeholders.
* Facilitate productive project meetings, planning sessions, and other Agile activities, such as retrospectives and after-action reviews.
* Continually improve project management systems and operational processes.
* Coordinate quality reviews, approvals, and final delivery requirements.

**What We're Looking For**

* At least five years of professional project management experience.
* Degree or certification in Project Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong proficiency with Smartsheet, including project schedules, dashboards, reports, workflow development, and automation.
* Experience designing and maintaining effective project management systems.
* Proven ability to manage multiple complex projects, schedules, budgets, and resources.
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience applying Agile project management principles.
* Ability to anticipate problems, recommend solutions, and work independently.
* Professionalism, accountability, and a collaborative approach to teamwork.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience coordinating video production, content development, instructional design, or other specialized creative and technical workflows.

**Work Arrangement**

DVITS operates under a Flexible Workplace Policy. This position may be performed remotely from an approved U.S. work location; Atlanta residency is not required.

Employees must be available during regular working hours of 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time and maintain a secure, professional working environment that meets company requirements.

Participation in scheduled company meetings and periodic in-person gatherings is required. Occasional business travel may be necessary.

Flexibility changes *where* we work. It does not change the standards by which we work.

You'll work alongside experienced professionals from military aviation, instructional design, technical training, and media production. You'll also have the opportunity to help shape and improve the systems that support our continued growth.

Mission First. Excellence Always.℠

We value initiative, accountability, collaboration, and people who take pride in the quality of their work.

Employment is contingent upon completion of applicable background and security screenings. Additional government security requirements may apply to assigned projects.

Submit your resume and a cover letter describing your relevant project management and Smartsheet experience to:

careers@dvitrainingsystems.com

jobs.description:

We recently completed a private placement financing and Alternative Public Offering and are now operating as a public company while maintaining our startup agility and innovation focus. **JOB SUMMARY/PURPOSE**

Deep Fission is seeking a Project Manager to support the planning, execution, and control of complex nuclear energy programs. This role is designed for a practitioner who can own delivery milestones while contributing to procurement and risk management efforts across the program.

The ideal candidate brings structured project management fundamentals combined with working knowledge of risk management practices such as risk register development and mitigation planning and ideally experience managing the procurement aspects of a project. jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Bonneville Labs is a flexible coworking and traditional lab space operator and developer optimized for a community of Bio-Doers, emerging biotechnology companies, community partners, and life sciences market leaders. Bonneville Labs believes that research and development organizations can innovate faster when their mind-share is freed up from operations to focus on discovery and product development. Bonneville Labs seeks to improve our world and lives by eliminating operational hurdles and reducing the cost of research and development for our member companies and allowing them to go forward, faster toward world changing discoveries and businesses.

**Program Manager, Operations and Strategy**
============================================

Reports To: CEO

**Job Overview**
----------------

Bonneville Labs advances transformative bio‑economy solutions by removing operational friction for emerging biotechnology companies. Our coworking and traditional lab spaces support a community of Bio‑Doers who innovate faster when freed from operational burdens.

The Senior Program Manager leads strategic programs and drives hands‑on operational execution across multiple Bonneville Labs sites. This role builds structured systems, harmonizes workflows, and ensures programs move from planning to completion with clarity, accountability, and measurable outcomes. The Senior Program Manager works at both the high‑level planning layer and the day‑to‑day execution layer to support operational excellence, member experience, and continuous improvement.

This role is essential for aligning timelines, goals, documentation, and operational systems across the Bonneville Labs ecosystem. The Senior Program Manager supports our product mindset by treating each site, service, and workflow as a versioned product that requires continuous improvement, measurable outcomes, and predictable release cycles.

**Responsibilities and Duties**
-------------------------------

### **Program Leadership and Oversight**

* Lead assigned programs from ideation through planning, launch, and completion.
* Balance strategic planning with hands‑on execution to keep programs moving without gaps or delays.
* Ensure each project phase has clear ownership, verified completion, and documented quality checks.
* Conduct post‑implementation reviews and initiate timely improvements when needed.
* Oversee program dashboards, timelines, and tracking systems using Smartsheets, UpKeep, and related platforms.
* Identify execution gaps and intervene to ensure corrective actions are taken.
* Provide coaching, oversight, and accountability management for the Project Supervisor.
* Translate operational needs into structured backlogs, sprints, and release cycles.
* Maintain consistent standards, workflows, and performance expectations across all sites.

### **Cross‑Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate work across Lab Operations, Lab Safety and Compliance, Facilities, Member Services, Community, Scientific Services, and Business Operations.
* Facilitate communication and reporting to ensure clarity of expectations, deliverables, and timelines.
* Lead cross‑functional project meetings, document decisions, and track action items.
* Support multi‑site initiatives and harmonization of processes across all Bonneville Labs locations.
* Serve as a central point of contact for program updates, escalations, and issue resolution.
* Partner with leadership to ensure programs support member experience, operational uptime, and regulatory compliance.
* Support KPI tracking across programs including uptime, NPS, SLA adherence, and operational efficiency.

### **Documentation and Quality Management**

* Develop, update, and implement SOPs, protocols, and operational documentation.
* Maintain document control procedures including version control, access permissions, and archival.
* Ensure documentation meets regulatory, safety, and quality standards in coordination with the Senior Manager of EHS.
* Convert tribal knowledge into structured, repeatable documentation that supports future site expansion.
* Support continuous improvement of the Quality Management System.
* Assist in development and implementation of Environmental Health and Safety Management Plans and operational guidelines.

### **Continuous Improvement and Product Mindset**

* Identify inefficiencies and propose improvements to workflows, systems, and processes.
* Implement tools and methodologies that enhance tracking, documentation, and reporting.
* Lead harmonization and continuous improvement projects across teams and sites.
* Support development of operational frameworks, testing services, and scalable systems for future sites.
* Recommend improvements that support member experience and operational excellence.
* Support automation initiatives such as ticket routing, asset tracking, and predictive maintenance pilots.
* Contribute to monthly or quarterly operational release notes.
* Coordinate predictable release cycles and communicate improvements across teams and to members.

### **Operations and Site Support**

* Support day‑to‑day operations across multiple Bonneville Labs sites.
* Assist with project planning and ownership of assigned operational systems.
* Provide onsite or virtual support for Bay Area sites as determined by leadership.
* Prepare detailed presentations summarizing program status, risks, and outcomes.
* Support emergency response coordination and communication with external stakeholders when needed.
* Ensure suppliers, contractors, and member companies comply with Bonneville Labs policies and safety guidelines.
* Support operational readiness for new site launches through documentation, playbooks, and process standardization.
* Monitor vendor and contractor performance to ensure service levels support operational uptime and member experience.

### **Stakeholder and Member Support**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal teams, external partners, and member companies.

jobs.description:
**About Apex Skin:**

We are Apex Skin, and our mission is to provide the highest quality dermatology and dermatologic surgery care to patients across Northeast Ohio with promptness, compassion, and excellence. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional patient experiences, offering same-day appointments, and serving our communities through education and meaningful care. Our team is dedicated to creating a supportive, patient-focused environment where excellence, empathy, and teamwork thrive.

**Position Overview**

Apex Skin is a physician-led and rapidly growing dermatology practice committed to delivering exceptional patient experiences. We are seeking a professional, customer-focused **Call Center Representative** to serve as the first point of contact for our patients. This role is responsible for answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, collecting and updating patient information, verifying insurance eligibility, and supporting patient communication needs while maintaining a high level of accuracy and compassion.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates strong communication and organizational skills, and is comfortable navigating multiple systems while providing exceptional patient service.

**Compensation**

Hourly Wage: $17-19.00 per hour

**Schedule**

* Full-time, Monday through Friday (8:00 am-4:30 pm)
* **Remote position for North East Ohio residents only**
* Schedule may vary slightly based on business and patient needs

**Essential Functions**

* Answer inbound patient calls promptly, professionally, and courteously
* Schedule, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments in accordance with Apex Skin protocols
* Complete patient pre-registration and accurately collect demographic and insurance information
* Verify insurance eligibility using EMR systems and verification platforms such as Optum or Availity
* Maintain accurate patient records while adhering to HIPAA and privacy standards
* Process pre-authorizations and assist with payment collection as needed
* Transmit correspondence and medical documentation securely and appropriately
* Collaborate with clinical and administrative teams to support patient care and scheduling needs
* Participate in required training sessions, team meetings, and operational updates
* Provide temporary support for on-site call center operations when business needs require
* Perform additional administrative duties as assigned
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Qualifications**

* Strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills
* Basic computer proficiency including Microsoft Office, email platforms, and EMR systems
* Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and remain calm under pressure
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Must reside in the state of Ohio
* Ability to maintain a quiet, professional, and distraction-free remote work environment
* One (1) year of experience in a medical office, healthcare scheduling, or call center environment preferred
* Familiarity with insurance verification processes and EMR systems preferred
* Prior dermatology or specialty healthcare experience preferred

**Career Growth Opportunities**

Motivated **Call Center Representative** may pursue:

* Apex Skin provides training, mentoring, and development opportunities for individuals who demonstrate skill, reliability, compassion, and clinical accuracy

**Remote Work Requirements**

* Apex Skin will provide a company phone and access to required call center software
* Employee must maintain reliable high-speed internet service (50 Mbps download recommended)
* Designated workspace must remain private, professional, and free from distractions during scheduled work hours
* All company equipment and patient information must be handled in compliance with Apex Skin privacy and security standards

**Physical Requirements & Work Environment**

* Prolonged periods of sitting while using a computer, headset, and phone system
* Frequent speaking, listening, and viewing of computer monitors throughout the workday
* Manual dexterity required for typing and operating standard office equipment
* Ability to occasionally lift up to 15 pounds for equipment or files
* Work is performed in a home office environment with controlled lighting and limited distractions
* Requires strong attention to detail, professionalism, and the ability to maintain productivity in a remote setting
* Required to adhere to HIPAA, OSHA, and Apex Skin privacy and safety standards

**Apex Skin Culture**  
Apex Skin fosters a collaborative, patient-first environment built on compassion, clinical excellence, and teamwork. We believe in a respectful and supportive workplace where employees feel valued, trusted, and empowered to contribute to exceptional patient experiences and meaningful clinical care.

jobs.description:

Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.

jobs.title: Client Support Manager
jobs.description:
**Who we are**

Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Central Ohio, we’re a privately-owned, independent healthcare navigation organization. We believe that no one should have to navigate the cost and complexity of healthcare alone, and we’re on a mission to make healthcare simpler and more effective for our millions of members. Our big-hearted, tech-savvy team fights to ensure that our members get the care they need, when they need it, at the most affordable cost – that’s why we call ourselves Healthcare Warriors®.

We’re committed to building diverse and inclusive teams – more than 2,000 of us and counting – so if you’re excited about this position, we encourage you to apply – even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement.

**Client Success Manager**
==========================

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
-------------------

Great client success is about more than managing an account. It’s about understanding what matters to the client, showing measurable value, and becoming a partner they don’t want to operate without.

As a Client Success Manager on our Emerging Growth Business Unit, you’ll help build and grow long-term client partnerships while connecting healthcare outcomes, cost management, and financial performance.

You’ll work across Product, Insights & Reporting, Sales, and other teams to turn data into meaningful client conversations, anticipate needs, solve problems, and help clients get the greatest possible value from our solutions.

If you enjoy building relationships, digging into the numbers, and turning insights into action, we’d love to meet you.

**WHERE YOU’LL WORK**
---------------------

This role can be based at our Dublin, Ohio office with hybrid flexibility or work remotely anywhere in the United States.

**WHAT YOU’LL MAKE HAPPEN**
---------------------------

* Build strong partnerships. Serve as a trusted day-to-day partner for assigned clients, building relationships that support satisfaction, retention, and long-term growth.
* Bring strategy to life. Understand each client’s priorities and mobilize internal teams around plans that drive adoption, engagement, and measurable results.
* Turn data into value. Use performance, engagement, and financial data to tell a clear story about results, savings, opportunities, and the value of our solutions.
* Stay ahead of client needs. Bring knowledge of health plans, market trends, and adjacent solutions to proactively recommend ideas that can make an impact.
* Know the health of the account. Monitor client performance and financial indicators to identify potential risks and opportunities before they become surprises.
* Be the client’s voice. Bring feedback and insights back to Product, Solutioning, Engineering, and other teams to help improve our solutions and client experience.
* Create confident users. Support onboarding, education, training, webinars, and workshops so clients and their partners understand how to get the most from our solutions.
* Connect the dots. Partner across Sales, Product, Marketing, Client Operations, and Insights to solve problems and deliver a seamless client experience.

**YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF...**

You’re equally comfortable building a client relationship, reviewing performance data, and explaining what the numbers mean for the business.

You bring:

* A bachelor’s degree in healthcare, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5–8+ years of client or account management experience within healthcare.
* A track record of building strong client relationships and delivering high levels of client satisfaction and retention.
* A strong understanding of the U.S. healthcare landscape, particularly health plans and the challenges they face.
* Excellent communication, presentation, project management, and relationship-building skills.
* Comfort interpreting and explaining financial analyses, savings, performance metrics, and business value to clients.
* An analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into useful insights and recommendations.
* Experience using CRM and client success tools, along with the ability to work independently in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment.
* Flexibility to travel as needed based on client demands and business cycles.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU**
------------------------

We want our people to feel supported at work and outside of it.

* Compensation: Competitive base pay, incentive plans, and employee referral bonuses.
* Coverage: Health, vision, and dental, plus life insurance, legal and identity protection, adoption assistance, EAP resources, TelaDoc services, and more.
* Retirement: 401(k) with up to a 4% employer match and full vesting from day one.
* Balance: PTO, seven paid holidays, parental leave, volunteer days, paid sabbaticals, and more.

* Culture: A people-first environment focused on collaboration, innovation, inclusion, community, and making a meaningful difference.

**About Us**

Snappy Kraken is a marketing program leader in the financial services industry.

**We believe that our work helps people achieve greater freedom.**

* Our tools help financial advisors achieve greater freedom over their time.
* Our content helps people achieve greater financial freedom for their families.
* Our culture helps team members achieve greater freedom in where (and how) to live and work.

**Our innovative solutions set us apart.**

* Financial content is stale; we make it interesting.
* Marketing technology is complex; we make it simple.
* Financial advisor brands are bland; we make them captivating.

**The Purpose of This Role**

The **Customer Success Manager (CSM)** is a full-time, remote position at Snappy Kraken. *Accessibility requirements are dependent on the role but could be expected during standard business hours Monday through Friday.* This position is open to any candidates currently residing and eligible to legally work in the United States or Canada.

As a CSM, you will oversee Freedom360, our premium all-in-one marketing solution for financial advisors. You will serve as the primary partner for our highest-value clients - building strong relationships, guiding them strategically, and ensuring the seamless delivery of all program components.

Your focus will be helping clients achieve **real business outcomes**: successful campaign launches, improved marketing performance, and stronger client engagement.

**Primary Role & Responsibilities**

* Manage a portfolio of Freedom360 clients, ensuring consistent delivery of all program elements.
* Conduct regular **business reviews** with clients, highlighting performance and demonstrating program ROI.
* Support the **renewal process** by reinforcing value and client outcomes.
* Lead onboarding, campaign preparation, approvals, and timely content publication.
* Provide insights and suggestions to help clients make the most of the program.
* Build strong client relationships through regular communication (chat, phone, email, video).
* Maintain accurate client records in our CRM.
* Work with the Freedom360 Program Lead to improve processes and client experience.

**Primary Qualifications**

* **2–4 years of Customer Success** with proven success managing client outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to lead **business reviews that showcase ROI and connect program value to client goals.**
* Experience in **SaaS customer success is required**; background in **Financial SaaS or Marketing Tech SaaS** is a strong plus.
* Strong communication and organizational skills.
* Comfortable presenting information and guiding client discussions.
* Tech-savvy, adaptable, and eager to learn new tools.
* Proactive and able to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Alignment with our core values: Pursue the Vision, Build Meaningful Relationships, Commit to Continuous Improvement, Solve with Purpose, Own Your Outcomes

**Perks & Benefits**

* Work Remotely
* Personal Days for when you need a break (on top of your regular vacation)
* Development Fund to help you grow
* Medical Insurance Options
* Parental/Maternity Leave
* Growth opportunities

As of November 2026, the expected compensation range for this position is **$60,000-65,000 USD/ $60,000-65,000 CAD** based on country of residence. This role is also eligible for **additional performance compensation** predicated on reaching quota or performance goals. Pay will be based on several factors, such as experience, certifications, location, market conditions, and other business and organizational needs. Snappy Kraken anticipates that the reasonably expected salary for this position could change in the future and retains the right to change or revisit the salary range according to business needs.

—

*As a remote company, it is critical to remember that our contributions and teams are interconnected and accessibility is the expectation.*

*At Snappy Kraken, diversity powers meaningful connections, impactful work, and great outcomes. Our culture of diversity and inclusion means we nurture an environment where each team member can do their best work.*

*The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as assigned by their supervisor.*

jobs.title: Manager of Customer Success
jobs.description:
**About DealerOn**

We are an online marketing company providing website and agency services to automotive dealerships across North and South America. We are known for our cutting-edge products that streamline the car buying process and provide an experience both shoppers and dealers love. Our business model is working: we were recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest growing companies six years in a row, expanding to over 30 manufacturer relationship, and over 5,000 dealer partners. We are proud of what our company has done, and it’s all due to the talented and diverse team we’ve been lucky enough to assemble.

**Job Description:**

The Manager of Customer Success harmonizes relationship cultivation with a dedication to team growth, upselling products and services to enhance website performance, and adept problem-solving to guarantee an outstanding customer experience. This multifaceted role encompasses customer retention, consultancy, mentorship, and coaching, alongside effective operational leadership, serving as the Voice of the Customer, and propelling data-driven process enhancements. Striking a balance between customer satisfaction and business objectives, the Manager of Customer Success occupies a central position in realizing organizational milestones and nurturing comprehensive customer success. This role is fully remote.

**Essential Functions:**

* Ensure effective communication, understanding, and implementation of strategy and customer KPIs across cross-functional teams, encompassing metrics such as Net Revenue Retention, Monthly Touch Points, Customer Satisfaction, Average Churn Score, SLAs, Quality Assurance, etc.
* Conduct annual performance reviews and quarterly goals for team members.
* Hold team accountable to departmental performance metrics and OKRs to foster continuous improvements.
* Conduct monthly team business reviews to address customer concerns and issues, providing solutions.
* Prioritize and enhance resolution of escalated customer issues; act as the escalation point for complex cases.
* Ensure employee performance aligns with company standards, conducting performance evaluations, and adhering to the progressive discipline process as per company policy.
* Conduct one-on-one meetings with CSMs to ensure daily tasks are accomplished and provide stakeholders with updates.
* Supervise daily team operations, including ensuring customer follow ups, reviewing of training codes, reviewing aging cases, responding and monitoring communication in slack rooms and email distributions.
* Verify that all team members have completed their training requirements.
* Keep the team updated weekly on all new information pertaining to products, procedures, customer needs, and company-related issues.
* Manage the interviewing and onboarding processes for new employees within the department.
* Utilize the Planner Board to track project statuses and provide updates to stakeholders.

**Required Skills/Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, marketing, project management, business administration, or a related field.
* Over **5 years of managerial experience**, demonstrating effective team leadership.
* Outstanding communication abilities, capable of clearly explaining technical matters to various audiences.
* Proven track record of achieving or surpassing metrics, upselling, quotas, and KPIs, with favorable customer feedback.
* Exceptional customer service skills, coupled with technical proficiency and the capacity to handle time-sensitive tasks in a fast-paced setting.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and other essential business software applications.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, JIRA, or similar tracking systems is preferred.

**Preferred Skills/Experience:**

* Previous management of Enterprise level accounts.
* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.
* Expertise in the automotive digital marketing industry.

#LI-Remote

**This position is open to US residents only.**

**The targeted salary range for this position is $62,800 - $91,550.**

The posted salary range for this position may be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as experience and training; internal pay equity; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Our Talent Acquisition Team will be happy to answer any questions.

**Perks and Benefits:**

Aside from the awesome people you will get to interact with on a daily basis, we offer a number of benefits, including:

* Medical, dental and vision insurance
* Company matched 401K plan
* Flexible PTO + Sick Leave
* 6 weeks paid Parental Leave
* 8 Paid National Holidays
* Company-paid basic Life Insurance
* Voluntary supplemental Life Insurance
* Voluntary long-term/short-term disability insurance
* Voluntary Pet Insurance
* Optional Healthcare/Dependent Care FSA Account

We also participate in E-Verify (for more information, click here: E-Verify Participation and Right to Work). A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

jobs.title: Outbound Customer Experience Supervisor
jobs.description:
Redwood Services is a national home services platform that partners with leading HVAC, plumbing, and electrical companies to help them grow and better serve their customers. As we continue to expand, we’re hiring an Outbound Customer Experience Supervisor to lead our welcome call team supporting tuck-in acquisitions. This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll guide, coach, and support a team of Outbound Customer Experience Specialists while also making welcome calls yourself every day. The work isn’t sales-heavy or transactional. It’s about creating a great first impression, building trust, and gathering key customer information while introducing customers to their new service partner. If you’re an energetic, personable leader who leads by example and thrives in a fast-paced, high-volume calling environment, this is an opportunity to play a critical role in the success of every acquisition we make.

**Responsibilities:**

*Team Leadership*

* Supervise, coach, and support a team of Outbound Customer Experience Specialists to meet daily call volume and quality goals.
* Monitor call activity, outcomes, and data accuracy, providing real-time feedback and ongoing coaching.
* Train new team members on call flow, systems, and the VIP text club offer.
* Track and report team performance, flagging trends, challenges, and opportunities to leadership.
* Manage team schedules and coverage across multiple time zones.
* Serve as the first point of escalation for difficult calls or customer concerns.
* Model a positive, professional, and engaging tone that sets the standard for the team.

*Hands-On Calling*

* Make outbound welcome calls daily to existing customers of newly acquired companies, with a call volume balanced alongside leadership responsibilities.
* Introduce the new partnership between the customer’s current service provider and one of Redwood’s partner companies, ensuring customers feel confident and informed about the transition.
* Collect and update customer information accurately in the system.
* Invite customers to join the VIP text club and explain the benefits clearly.
* Handle inbound calls as needed and assist with basic scheduling when customers request service.
* Navigate multiple systems and platforms efficiently while documenting call outcomes.

**Qualifications:**

* Three (3)+ years of outbound call center experience, including at least one (1) year in a supervisor, team lead, or similar leadership role.
* **Candidates must live in the Memphis area. This role is remote, but you will be required to come into the office as needed.**
* Proven ability to lead by example while personally maintaining a high daily call volume.
* Experience coaching, monitoring call quality, and driving team performance to goals.
* Comfortable using call data and metrics to track performance and guide decisions.
* Open to starting as a full-time contractor with the opportunity to transition into a W2 employee with benefits based on performance and business needs.
* Ability to lead effectively in a remote environment with strong self-management and accountability.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule across time zones (typical shifts between 9am and 8pm depending on region).
* Strong communication skills with a friendly, confident phone presence.
* Tech-savvy and able to quickly learn new systems and teach them to others.
* Detail-oriented with strong data entry accuracy.
* Experience with ServiceTitan is a plus.
* Background in HVAC, plumbing, or home services is a plus.

**If you enjoy connecting with people, developing a team, and being part of work that directly impacts customer retention and growth, we’d love to hear from you.**
