jobs.title: Expert Support Manager (Contract, San Francisco)
jobs.description:
**About Patronus AI**
---------------------

Patronus AI is a frontier lab developing simulation research and infrastructure to accelerate progress toward human-aligned AGI. We are on a mission to simulate all of the world's intelligence.

We are the team behind some of the earliest and most influential research in AI evaluation like FinanceBench, Lynx, SimpleSafetyTests, CopyrightCatcher, Humanity's Last Exam, and more. We are formerly AI researchers and engineers from companies like Meta AI, Amazon AGI, and Google. Our customers include foundation model labs and Fortune 500 enterprises like Adobe. We are backed by top-tier investors like Lightspeed Venture Partners, Notable Capital, Stanford University, Noam Brown, Gokul Rajaram, and more.

**At a glance**
---------------

* Engagement: Independent contractor, on site
* Pay: $50/hr - 150/hr
* Start: Rolling
* Location: San Francisco headquarters, in office 5 days a week
* Team: Expert Operations

**The role**
------------

Our work is produced by practicing domain experts on contract, across many specialist domains. You keep them working.

When an expert cannot submit, cannot access a project, or has not been paid what they expected, that is yours. It covers onboarding paperwork and access, tooling and environment problems, and the whole invoicing and payment path from submitted work to money arriving. Volume is high and it spans every domain we hire into, so you will be the one person who sees the same breakage three times and goes and fixes the cause.

Getting paid correctly and on time is the clearest signal of whether a company is worth working for.

This is a position of trust. You will see what people are owed and you will sit on the path that money takes to reach them. We hire for that first and the rest second. It is also why the role is on site with the team rather than remote.

To support close collaboration, this role is based in our San Francisco headquarters and requires in-office attendance 5 days a week.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run the support queue for the expert bench: onboarding and access, tooling and environment issues, invoicing and payment questions. Resolve what you can, escalate what you cannot, and keep an honest record of both.
* Own the payment path end to end. Know what is owed, what has been submitted, what has been approved and what has actually landed, and chase the gaps before anyone has to ask you.
* Get new experts set up and productive: accounts, access, contracts, payment details, and the first week of small problems that stop people starting.
* Work with the expert managers who own the relationships. They know their people, you know the systems, and an expert should never have to work out which of you to ask.
* Fix causes, not tickets. When the same issue arrives for the third time, write the documentation, change the workflow, or take it to the engineers who own the tool.
* Tell us plainly when a process is the problem.
* Use AI aggressively. Triage, drafting, reconciliation and reporting should all be automated as far as they go, so your hours are spent on the cases that need a person.

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

**Required**

* Three or more years in high-volume support, operations or contractor and payroll operations, with people rather than companies as the customer.
* You are comfortable with money. Invoices, rates, approvals, corrections, and the conversation when someone has been underpaid.
* Precision under volume. A payments mistake is not a typo to the person it happens to.
* A track record of being trusted with money or sensitive personal data, and references who will say so without hesitating.
* Clear, calm writing in professional English. Most of this job happens in text, often with someone who is frustrated and has the right to be.
* Ability to work independently, prioritising without being told what is urgent, while working alongside experts in time zones that are not yours.
* Enough technical confidence to debug an access or environment problem a step or two before escalating.
* Comfort working inside internal tooling that is still being built, and reporting the bugs rather than working around them.

**Nice to have**

* Experience supporting a contingent, freelance or marketplace workforce.
* Experience with international contractor payments, including the ways they fail.
* Familiarity with ticketing and support tooling, and with building the macros and documentation behind it rather than only using it.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

You are not the point of contact for an expert's work. Feedback, performance and retention sit with the expert managers, and the quality bar sits with the quality team. Your job is to make sure nobody is blocked by anything other than the work itself.

**How hiring works**
--------------------

* Resume review and a conversation with Talent Operations
* A practical exercise: a real support and payments scenario, handled in writing
* Interview with the team you will sit with
* Reference checks, and a background check before you start
* Onboarding and your first week on the queue

*Patronus AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected* *characteristics.*

jobs.title: Customer Onboarding & Training Specialist
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.

RB Retail & Service Solutions, part of the Fullsteam organization, provides business management software for the pool and spa industry. Since 2003, we have helped retailers, service companies, and construction businesses streamline operations and improve efficiency through innovative software solutions.

  

We are seeking a motivated, customer-focused **Customer Onboarding & Training Specialist** to guide new customers through software implementation, onboarding, and training. This role ensures customers feel confident using our software, understand its functionality, and are prepared to incorporate it into their daily operations.

  

**Primary Responsibilities:**
-----------------------------

**Customer Onboarding & Implementation**

* Manage the onboarding process from initial welcome through implementation and transition to ongoing support.
* Lead kickoff meetings to understand customer needs, workflows, and business goals.
* Develop customized onboarding and training plans.
* Coordinate software setup, configuration, and implementation with internal teams.
* Track progress, address challenges, and ensure customers are prepared to use the software successfully.
* Conduct follow-ups to evaluate customer satisfaction and adoption.

**Customer Training & Education**

* Deliver engaging software training through virtual meetings, webinars, and individual or group sessions.
* Explain software features, workflows, and best practices using real-world examples.
* Adapt training to different experience levels and learning styles.
* Identify additional training needs and promote customer confidence and independence.

**Training Content Development**

* Create and maintain training materials, including videos, tutorials, user guides, webinars, and step-by-step documentation.
* Develop and update FAQs, knowledge base articles, and self-service resources.
* Create interactive product walkthroughs and in-application training.
* Keep educational materials current with software updates and new features.
* Collaborate with internal teams to identify common customer questions and improve training resources.

**Customer Success & Collaboration**

* Build strong customer relationships through proactive communication and support.
* Set clear expectations for onboarding timelines and customer responsibilities.
* Monitor customer engagement and provide additional guidance when needed.
* Partner with Sales, Customer Support, Account Management, and Product Development to ensure a smooth customer experience.
Communicate customer feedback and recommend improvements to onboarding and training processes.  

  

**Required Skills & Experience:**
---------------------------------

* Experience in software training, customer onboarding, customer success, technical support, or a related customer-facing role.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to nontechnical audiences.
* Excellent organizational, time-management, and multitasking skills.
* Ability to manage multiple customers and deadlines simultaneously.
* Comfortable leading virtual presentations and training sessions.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-first mindset.
* Ability to quickly learn new software and business processes.
* Experience creating professional training materials and documentation.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Teams, Zoom, or similar tools.
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with internal teams.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with SaaS products or business management software.
* Familiarity with retail, point-of-sale, inventory management, or service scheduling.
* Experience with CRM, customer support, or onboarding platforms such as Zoho or HubSpot.
* Familiarity with learning management systems, Canva, Product Fruits, or similar tools.
* Experience creating instructional videos, webinars, and interactive tutorials.
Previous experience developing structured onboarding or software training programs.  

**Salary range: $85,000 - $95,000 USD**

Fullsteam supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience, and background. Fullsteam is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, veteran status, marital status, creed, status with regard to public assistance, genetic status or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.

**HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT**

As the sales enablement lead, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by helping advance the goals of USGBC and GBCI. In this role, you'll take ownership of building the knowledge, skills, tools, and working practices that enable sales and account teams to engage customers, communicate value, and execute the commercial model effectively.

You will lead the development and implementation of a consistent, scalable global sales enablement program that supports commercial teams across all regions, while accounting for regional market dynamics, customer needs, and business priorities.

You'll design and manage onboarding, learning programs, sales playbooks, practical training, and ongoing reinforcement in partnership with regional directors, market leads, product, marketing, client solutions, and sales operations. You'll also provide partner enablement where assigned.

You'll report to the director of sales operations and work closely with regional directors, market leads, account management, client solutions, product, marketing, and technology teams to support sales success across all global regions and markets.

As a global individual contributor and program lead, you will establish consistent enablement standards, share best practices across regions, and ensure that sales teams have the resources and capabilities needed to effectively represent USGBC and GBCI products and services worldwide.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Global sales enablement strategy and readiness:** assess role-based capability needs using manager input, field observations, customer and partner feedback, and performance data. Develop and execute a global sales enablement plan that aligns with organizational priorities, addresses regional capability gaps, and establishes consistent sales readiness standards across all markets.

Establish content ownership, version control, review cycles, and retirement procedures to maintain accurate and current materials. Create a centralized, consistent approach to sales enablement resources that supports global accessibility and knowledge sharing.
* **Sales training, coaching, and skill development:** facilitate workshops, demonstrations, role-playing exercises, peer learning, and manager coaching resources to strengthen sales effectiveness. * **Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder alignment:** work closely with the director of sales operations, regional directors, market leads, account managers, product, marketing, client solutions, technology, and hr/learning teams to align enablement initiatives with organizational priorities. Serve as the central coordination point for global sales enablement activities, facilitating consistent communication, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across regions.

Develop system training, user guides, and adoption resources that enable global teams to effectively utilize customer relationship management (crm), learning, and sales enablement platforms.

* HVAC, plumbing, and electrical companies

* Pest control and landscaping services
* Cleaning and restoration companies

* Inbound call answering and customer support

* Customer reactivation campaigns
* Sales and service follow-up calls

* Subscription-based businesses
* Professional services companies
* Technology and software companies

* Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or new client acquisition

Program Coordinator (5156C), Summer Sessions, Study Abroad, Lifelong Learning & University Extension About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
Summer Sessions, Study Abroad, Lifelong Learning & University Extension (SSALLEX) is the extended education division of the University of California, Berkeley and an essential part of the University's mission to extend the research and scholarship of UC Berkeley to a global community.
  
  
SSALLEX is a vibrant and dynamic organization that enables more than 60,000 visiting UC and potential Cal students; parents, faculty, academic units, international business partners, and central campus service providers engage in campus activities. The department provides more than 2,000 summer courses, early-start programs, study abroad experiences, global internships, and year-around programs or courses, lectures, special events and interest circles for older adults.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Based on the continued growth and expansion of the First-Year Edge & Transfer Edge program, the Program Coordinator is needed to support the execution and management of the program's operations. This position would work with the Director and would be responsible for applying advanced student services expertise and coordinating the academic advising, logistical, programmatic, and administrative operations of the First-Year Edge & Transfer Edge summer program for newly admitted UC Berkeley students.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is November 23, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Academic Advising - 30%
  
  
Apply full range of student support services to newly admitted students pursuing the First-Year Edge & Transfer Edge program.
  
Provide on-going advising to prospective and matriculated students, families, and legal guardians and effectively manage a high volume of inquiries from prospective and matriculated students as well as campus and internal partners
  
Advise Director on university and program specific policies and procedures as well as program development, administration and general logistics.
  
Advise students on topics such as but not limited to eligibility requirements, opt-in/opt-out process, financial aid, academics, housing, support services, and resources for the course enrollment process.
  
  
Resolve Student Services-related Issues and Grievances - 10%
  
  
Resolve student services-related issues and grievances during and after the course of the program, including course enrollment, billing, withdrawal/cancellation, appeals process, and other related inquiries.
  
  
Recruitment and Outreach - 10%
  
  
Plan, implement and participate in virtual, local, domestic, and other outreach events and recruitment opportunities primarily in California as well as hosting and facilitating in-person and online outreach events, such as information sessions and pre-program webinars
  
  
Student Conduct - 5%
  
  
Responsible for interpreting organization policies and advising students and faculty on student conduct, student grievances, disputes, and issues regarding discrimination.
  
  
Student Orientation - 5%
  
  
Oversees and may conduct orientations of new students.
  
  
Events - 5%
  
  
Plan and implement student programming, events and orientations aimed at equipping newly admitted first-year and transfer students with the knowledge to succeed during the course of the program and in their transition to UC Berkeley
  
  
Alumni Recruitment Network - 5%
  
  
Develops and enhances an alumni recruitment network. Including coordinating the recruitment, hiring, and training process of student staff including program assistants and program ambassadors
  
  
Emergency and Crisis - 5%
  
  
Support emergency and crisis management intervention
  
  
Confidential Conduct Records - 5%
  
  
Maintain confidential conduct records as defined by FERPA, Clery, Title IX, and other regulations
  
  
Student Databases and Analysis - 5%
  
  
Create, update, and maintain student databases and provide data insights and analysis when needed.
  
  
Program Literature and Resources - 5%
  
  
Develop and maintain program literature and resources, including program website and knowledge base, and maintain external and on-going communication to various constituents
  
  
Administrative and Operational Tasks - 5%
  
  
Coordinating administrative and operational tasks including but not limited to making purchases, invoice and vendor payments, expense pre-approvals, and reimbursements
  
  
Evaluate Programs and Make Recommendations - 5%
  
  
Evaluate short-term and long-term success of programs and make recommendations to changes in policy, practice, and procedure accordingly.

MPS Program Coordinator (4973C) - MPS Dean's Office About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and providing space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Pla n, which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride.
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The MPS Dean's Diversity Office initiates, implements, and evaluates efforts and conducts research on student, postdoc, and faculty success in the mathematical and physical science fields with an emphasis on ensuring fair access and equitable outcomes. The Assistant Dean and their staff organize new initiatives, develop new funding, and support departmental efforts to students, and receive all work duties directly from the Assistant Dean. Collaborates with professors, graduate students, postdoctoral fellows, faculty, staff, and administrators from UCB and national partners.
  
  
Currently projects underway include MPS Scholars and the MPS Scholarship Program at the undergraduate level, a doctoral advancement program, and a postdoc study. This position is responsible for providing programmatic, administrative, and financial coordination for MPS Dean's Office. Provides support to the Assistant Dean. The Assistant Dean advises the Deans and Department Chairs, manages and provides assistance to several student organizations, conducts research, develops new programs, and works to enhance equity among the faculty, staff, and students in the MPS departments.
  
  
The position requires in-depth understanding of campus policies and administrative practices. The position holder is a key point of contact for all MPS Dean's Office business and must be able to work with a high degree of independence with good judgement and follow through.
  
  
MPS Scholars is the official student success and mentorship program of the Mathematical and Physical Sciences (MPS) Dean's Office, offered collaboratively with the Departments of Astronomy, Earth and Planetary Science, Mathematics, and Physics. Open to all intended and declared MPS majors, MPS Scholars provides opportunities to build community, explore academic and career pathways, and thrive throughout the Berkeley experience.
  
  
Since launching in Fall 2022, thousands of students have participated in MPS Scholars through mentorship, events, workshops, and academic and career resources.
  
  
MPS Scholars is a structured program, supported by funding from the Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation. It provides activities and opportunities such as: A supportive mentoring network of advanced students, faculty, professional scientists, and alumni. Welcome and orientation programs for incoming students. Research and internship opportunities in academic and industry settings. Career development workshops, courses, networking events, and graduate school preparation. Academic resources designed to support success in MPS majors. Retreats, social events, and community-building activities that connect students with peers, graduate mentors, staff, alumni, and faculty across the MPS departments.
  
  
The Mathematical and Physical Sciences Scholarship Program (MPSSP) awards up to $15,000 per year in scholarship support to eligible students in Astronomy, Earth and Planetary Science, Mathematics, and Physics. Funded by the National Science Foundation's S-STEM program, MPSSP scholars receive financial support while participating fully in the MPS Scholars community.
  
  
At the graduate level, a bridge grant from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation grant is focused on establishing a prototype for the establishment of a Sloan Center for Systemic Change (SCSC) at Berkeley by establishing a consortium of departments working together to advance their equity goals.
  
  
At the postdoctoral level, the Postdoc Study, supported by a grant from the Heising-Simons Foundation, is designed to provide a clearer understanding of the experiences of postdoctoral scholars and causes of patterns of career selection among postdocs in the MPS fields at top-tier universities and national research facilities.
  
  
The MPS Program Coordinator coordinates and administers academic support and student success programs within the Mathematical and Physical Sciences (MPS) Dean's Office, including MPS Scholars and the NSF S-STEM Scholarship Program. The position supports the development and implementation of programs designed to enhance the academic, professional, and personal success of undergraduate and graduate students, with particular attention to students who may face barriers to academic success.
  
  
Working under the direction of the Assistant Dean and in collaboration with faculty, staff, students, and campus and external partners, the Program Coordinator provides programmatic support, coordinates mentoring and professional development activities, supports students in navigating academic and other challenges, and assists with program assessment and evaluation. The position also coordinates program communications and outreach, supervises student and peer staff,

new_jobs.description:
**Care Coordinator - Home Care** (Concord / East Bay)

**Schedule**: Full-time, primarily Monday–Friday

**Work Arrangement**: Approximately 80% field-based, 20% office-based

**Reports To**: Operations Manager

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The External Care Coordinator (ECC) is a field-based sales professional responsible for driving new client acquisition throughout the Concord/East Bay territory.

This role focuses on building relationships with healthcare and community referral partners, generating new business opportunities, and guiding prospective clients and families through the sales process—from initial inquiry and in-home consultation to assessment and enrollment.

We're looking for a motivated, relationship-driven individual who enjoys being out in the community, building connections, and helping families find the right care solutions.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Referral Development & Business Generation**

* Build and maintain relationships with healthcare, senior living, and community referral partners.
* Conduct outreach, visits, and presentations to generate qualified referrals.

**2. Initial Inquiry & Pipeline Ownership**

* Respond to inquiries, qualify prospective clients, and schedule consultations.
* Manage timely follow-up and track opportunities through the sales pipeline.

**3. In-Home Consultations, Assessments & Closing**

* Conduct in-home consultations and assessments; recommend services based on client needs.
* Present pricing, address concerns, and secure signed service agreements and intake paperwork.

**4. Sales-to-Operations Handoff**

* Provide Operations with complete assessments, agreements, and client expectations.
* Coordinate an accurate, timely handoff to support the start of care.

**5. Cross-Functional Support & Additional Responsibilities**

* Participate in caregiver training and orientation to learn company care standards and assessment practices.
* Assist with client reassessments, quality assurance visits, caregiver education, or other operational needs as assigned.

**WORK STRUCTURE & INDEPENDENT DECISION-MAKING**

The ECC is expected to spend at least 80% of their time in the field, focused on referral development, business development, and prospective client consultations.

Although the position reports to the Operations Manager, the ECC independently manages their schedule, prioritizes sales opportunities, and develops strategies to achieve business growth objectives.

The position exercises independent judgment in evaluating client needs, recommending services, and negotiating pricing within established company guidelines.

**COMPENSATION**

* **Base salary**: $70,500 – $75,000 annually
* Performance-based incentives tied to new client acquisition and business development
* Company-provided vehicle, with company-paid fuel and maintenance for business use.
* Position designated as exempt under the applicable outside-sales exemption, subject to the duties actually performed and applicable law.

Pay: $70,500.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Briefly describe any experience you have building or maintaining professional relationships with referral sources (such as hospitals, senior living communities, or healthcare professionals). If you don't have direct experience, tell us how you feel about developing these relationships and helping generate new clients
* Briefly describe your experience assessing client care needs, developing care plans, or recommending appropriate care services.
